results.title: Banshee
results.cliff: Rabbit is dead by his own daughter's hand, Proctor has become a killer of civilians as well as criminals, and the real Lucas Hood's body has surfaced. His son Jason has already recognised the impostor wearing his father's badge.

flags.claim: His son Jason has already recognised the impostor wearing his father's badge
flags.evidence: In a post-credits scene, Jason Hood, son of the real Lucas Hood, is shown watching a YouTube video of the fight between Mr. Sanchez and the unnamed protagonist as Lucas Hood.
flags.correction: Jason is shown watching a video of the impostor, but the source does not state that he has recognised him as an impostor — only that he is watching the footage.

results.title: Banshee
results.cliff: Rabbit is finally dead, the diamonds were always fake, and Rebecca has crossed the line into killing for Kai. Emmett has been murdered by white supremacists, Deva has just learned Lucas is her real father, and Chayton Littlestone is on his way back to Banshee to avenge Alex Longshadow.

flags.claim: Chayton Littlestone is on his way back to Banshee to avenge Alex Longshadow
flags.evidence: He is informed of Longshadow's death and decides to return to Banshee.
flags.correction: Chayton decides to return to Banshee upon hearing of Longshadow's death, but the source does not state his motive is to avenge Alex — Chayton leads the Redbones gang that was in conflict with Longshadow's tribal leadership, not allied with him.

results.title: Banshee
results.cliff: Chayton is dead, but the cost was Siobhan and Gordon, with Job taken alive by unknown hands. Lucas has taken off the badge; Carrie is a widow who has killed her lover's captor; Proctor is free and intrigued by the vacuum Lucas is leaving.

results.title: Banshee
results.cliff: Rebecca is buried, her killer buried by Kai's own hand. Kai stands alone against six cartel guns; Lucas has left Banshee and Job has left for New York. Agent Dawson has walked away with a file that names Lucas as an impostor.
Mount Weather is a graveyard and Clarke has walked away from her people, unable to face what she did. Jaha has found an AI who thanks him for delivering her a nuclear warhead.
Earth is gone. The survivors are in cryosleep on the Eligius ship, headed for a distant world Monty found, chaperoned by his son Jordan.
The world has burned and healed. Clarke and Madi are alive in the only fertile valley left, watched over by a strange spacecraft that has just descended from orbit.
A.L.I.E. is dead and the world is free of the chip. In the same breath, Clarke has learned that the surface is about to become uninhabitable, and has told only Bellamy.
Clarke and the surviving kids are prisoners inside the pristine Mount Weather facility. Above them the Ark is coming apart: Jaha has sent the stations down to Earth and stayed behind to die.

Humanity is over as a species: nearly everyone has transcended into a form of light. Clarke, denied the test for killing Cadogan, is left alone on the regrown Earth — until her friends choose to come back down and live out mortal lives with her.

The series ends with Cole erased and reinserted into a new timeline where the plague, Project Splinter and the 12 Monkeys never existed. Cassie remembers everything, and she and Cole each find their way back to the farmhouse they once shared.

Athan is dead by Olivia's hand, and Olivia — revealed as the true Witness the Army was worshipping all along — is bringing Titan into 2046 to destroy Project Splinter. In 2015, young Cole is handed a cryptic note from a mother he was told he never knew.

Titan has splintered away to 2163 with a pregnant Cassie inside, where the Army greets her as the mother of the Witness. Cole is chasing after her; Jennifer is stranded in World War I; Ramse has vanished pursuing Olivia and Sam; the facility is gone.

Tyler has just attempted a school shooting that Clay defused, and Clay is standing outside the school holding the rifle as sirens approach. Bryce is walking free on probation and, quietly, Chloë is carrying his baby.

The story closes with Justin dead of AIDS, Bryce's murder permanently closed with Monty still blamed for it, and everyone graduating from Liberty scarred but intact. Alex is a killer no court will ever know about, and the group carries the weight together.

The Bakers' trial has just begun and everything is in motion at once: Alex is in critical condition with a gunshot wound, Jessica has finally told her father about her rape, and Tyler is quietly assembling an arsenal.

The group has framed the dead Monty for Bryce's murder, and Alex's own cop father is quietly protecting his son by destroying evidence. But Winston, Monty's secret lover, knows Monty was with him that night — and a fisherman has just dredged up Tyler's bag of guns from the river.
The Primes are overthrown, but Sheidheda has escaped into some unknown host, and Octavia has just been stabbed by Diyoza's now-adult daughter Hope and pulled through the anomaly.

Dunk and Egg leave Ashford as hedge knight and runaway prince, bound for Dorne. Behind them, Baelor is dead, Aerion is exiled to the Free Cities to nurse a grudge, and Maekar has just discovered his youngest son is gone.
Wednesday has revealed himself as Odin and open war with the New Gods has begun. Shadow, finally a believer, turns to find Laura waiting for him.
Shadow has learned Wednesday is his father, taken a new identity, and gone north alone. Laura carries Sweeney's body and has decided to kill Wednesday. Gungnir is hidden.

Wednesday is dead by Laura's spear but his corpse has vanished from the vigil, having claimed Shadow's demigod blood as sacrifice. Shadow has died on the World Tree. Mr. Ibis warns something worse than the death of the Old Gods is coming.

The Centre wants Paige recruited as a second-generation illegal, the way it recruited Jared. Stan has made a decision about Nina that will change his standing at the FBI, and Martha is handing FBI files to a husband she knows only as Clark.
Paige has just told Pastor Tim that her parents are Soviet spies. Philip and Elizabeth do not know she has done it. Reagan is on TV calling the USSR an evil empire.

Kimmy's father becoming CIA Soviet-division chief has trapped the Jenningses in America. The trip home is cancelled, Elizabeth is taking all new operations herself, and Henry is barred from the boarding school he earned.
Philip and Elizabeth are in Moscow after Stan let them escape. Paige stepped off the train at the US border to stay behind, and Henry is at boarding school with no idea his parents are gone.

Cassie, gutshot, has just splintered into 2043 as Deacon's twelve raiders storm the temporal facility and Jones surrenders the machine. Cole is left in 2015 without a way home, and in 1947-vintage secrecy the Army readies twelve mysterious newborns for something 28 years away.

Elizabeth is recovering from a gunshot wound in a Jennings safe house, the FBI has a sketch of a thirtyish spy couple, and Nina has just handed Arkady a file on Stan. Paige has begun searching the house for whatever her parents are hiding.

Cassian has just handed himself to Luthen's rebellion. Bix flees Ferrix broken by torture, Mon Mothma is trading her daughter's future for cover, and the ISB now knows there is a network — 'Axis' — to hunt.
Green Gables is saved for now, with Anne officially a Cuthbert and two smiling strangers taken in as boarders under the roof. Gilbert has left Avonlea for the sea after his father's death.
Bash and Mary have just married and Miss Stacy has kept her post, while Gilbert is back in Avonlea and openly cordial with Anne. Cole has fled bullying for a new life with Josephine in Charlottetown.

Anne and Gilbert have declared their love and promised to write, but she is off to Queen's College and he to the University of Toronto for medicine. Ka'kwet remains locked inside the residential school, her parents barred from taking her home.

The war is over and most of its main players are gone. Jayce and Viktor have vanished destroying the wild rune, Ambessa is dead, Jinx has seemingly killed herself saving Vi from Vander, and the survivors — Vi, Caitlyn, Sevika, Mel, Ekko — are left to build whatever comes next.

Jinx has fired a Hextech rocket at Piltover's Council chamber in the same minute they voted to grant Zaun its independence. Silco is dead in her arms and nobody watching yet knows who in that chamber survived.

Ash has fled toward retirement in Florida, having bargained with Ruby — the true author of the Necronomicon — to let her release an evil she promises she can control. Sinkholes are already tearing open around the world.

William is dead with the FBI holding his dying words about a spy couple with two children. Arkady has been expelled, Martha is in Moscow, and Philip has just told Paige to end things with Stan's son Matthew.
Elk Grove finally reveres Ash as its hero, but an alternate-timeline Ruby watches him from afar and the Necronomicon has been picked up by an unknown traveler at the ruins of the cabin.
Luthen is dead but his final intelligence has surfaced an Imperial superweapon. Cassian is flying to Kafrene to meet Saw Gerrera's informant while Bix, hidden offworld, is raising their child.

The Titans are people, turned by an unseen enemy who commands them from beyond the walls. Reiner and Bertholdt have fled with Ymir toward that enemy, having failed to take Eren but knowing now what he is, and a bearded man in the Beast Titan is planning the next move.

The Rumbling has started. Thousands of Wall Titans are trampling toward Marley to exterminate every human beyond Paradis, and the only force that can stop Eren is a fragile alliance of yesterday's enemies sailing toward Odiha with a wounded Levi and a broken Reiner.

There is a whole world of humans beyond the sea, and the nation of Marley calls Eren's people devils. Erwin is dead, the throne is Historia's, and Eren stands at the ocean asking whether killing everyone on the other side is the only way to be free.
Doug is wearing his wedding ring again and Sam is moving in with Zahid. Casey has claimed Izzie and UCLA in the same breath, while Paige lands unexpectedly inside Julia's life as her nanny.

Ash saved the world by killing Kandar the Destroyer, but woke injured and alone in a postapocalyptic future — met by a stranger named Lexx and a heavily modified Delta 88, with no sign of Brandy, Kelly, or Pablo.
The North survives, but at the cost of Yue and the Moon Spirit's balance. Aang still needs earth and fire, and the Fire Nation now knows a comet is coming that will make them unstoppable.

The walls that were meant to protect humanity are themselves made of Titans. Annie is beyond reach in her own crystal, and Eren and his friends now know human shifters serve an enemy hidden inside the walls.

Doug has just discovered Elsa's affair through a note his own daughter wrote. The family walks into S2 with a secret that has already detonated, and Sam is alone romantically after telling Paige he doesn't love her.
Sam heads to Denton with Paige beside him and Bailey in the shadows. Doug still cannot forgive Elsa, and Casey and Izzie hold hands without letting go.
Grace has killed JP and moved in with Eva; her sisters, Roger and Matt all share the secret, and JP's father George lies undiscovered in the pond behind the house.

Spencer has been offered a way out of Anderson Financial to build something with Joe, Charles has been handed a route back onto an NFL field, and Vernon is finally seeing Reggie clearly — with his money and his career hanging on what he does about it.
Detective Moss lies dead at Gene's cabin, Sally sleeps unaware, and Barry once again declares his killing life over — while Gene has just heard the shots that changed everything.
Ba Sing Se has fallen from the inside, Aang is barely alive after Azula's lightning, and Iroh is in a Fire Nation prison. Zuko has chosen Azula over Katara's offer of trust.
Gene is free but has just realised Barry murdered the woman he loved; Barry believes his monastery rampage has buried the secret for good.

The show closes with Sam standing on Antarctic ice and Doug at his shoulder. Casey and Izzie have promised each other that whoever gets into UCLA has to go; Zahid is out of surgery and healing; Elsa and Doug have patched things together one more time.
Barry is dead by Gene's hand; Gene takes life in prison as the biopic rewrites the truth for John, who now sees his father as a hero.

Ian is alive in hospital, warned by the retiring Loftus to disappear and return Blánaid's money; Angelica sits in Houlihan's custody, and Houlihan has chosen to shield the sisters from the police force she still works for.
Norman has killed Bradley in a Mother-driven blackout and disappeared. Norma has resolved to institutionalise him but has no money, and Romero has broken with her over her lies about Sam's death.
Norman has slit his English teacher's throat during a blackout, remembers nothing, and walked home to Norma. His family knows he is unravelling but not what he has done.
Barry is in police custody for Janice Moss's murder; Sally has fled to Missouri after killing a man; Hank has saved Cristobal but is deeply changed by what it cost him.
Norman dies in Dylan's arms, thanking him for reuniting him with Norma. The motel and house are sold, and Dylan, Emma and their daughter walk away into a quiet life without the family that made them.

Jimmy has walked away from his one shot at legitimacy and told Mike he's done doing the right thing. Chuck, whose contempt he now sees clearly, is still the name partner in a firm that will keep freezing him out.
Norma is dead, and Norman — now living with her corpse and a full-time Mother hallucination — believes she is still alive. Romero is in jail, having lost the one person he loved to Norman.

Ryan is Gotham's Batwoman with Kate's blessing, but the Crows are gone and Batman's villain trophies — Poison Ivy's plants, Joker's acid-spraying flower, Mad Hatter's hat, Killer Croc's tooth and more — are drifting loose in a lawless city.

Chuck has Jimmy on tape admitting to a felony he thinks was a private moment of comfort. Mike, aiming at Hector to end the Salamanca problem, has just been silently overruled by someone else in the game.

The Bat-team have retaken Wayne Enterprises and reunited as a family, but a hazmat-suited news crew is attacked at the Batblimp crash site by a mangled, skeletal figure no one has identified. Alice is now oceans away, and Poison Ivy has escaped Gotham with Renee.

Norman remembers killing Miss Watson but the Mother persona answered on the polygraph and he passed with a smile. His family knows he is dangerously ill; the town's drug hierarchy has been reshuffled around him.
Lalo is alive and reported dead — free to plan a return against Gus. Kim has quit her firm and pitched a con to destroy Howard Hamlin's reputation that Jimmy is not sure he wants to run.

Jimmy is serving 86 years and has reclaimed both his name and the blame for Chuck. Kim, having confessed her own role, walks free but ruined. The last image is their signature finger-gun gesture as she leaves.

Alice is loose in the sewers decoding Lucius Fox's journal for a way to kill Batwoman, and Tommy Elliot walks free wearing Bruce Wayne's face. Kate is holding the Kryptonite shard Supergirl entrusted to her.

Bonnie has texted the others that she is going to confess to killing Perry, and Madeline, Celeste, Jane and Renata are walking into the Monterey police station beside her. Nobody has agreed on what any of them will actually say when they get inside.

Perry is dead on the stairs at trivia night, and Madeline, Celeste, Jane, Renata and Bonnie have told the police he tripped. Detective Quinlan does not believe them, and all five women know Bonnie pushed him.

The ASA's meta-kid conspiracy is public and Jefferson and Anissa are hailed as heroes, but Tobias has just opened Martin Proctor's briefcase — and whatever the government hid inside is now his to use against Black Lightning.
Tobias is behind bars but Odell has revealed he knows every secret identity in the family, and he is drafting the Pierces as ASA soldiers against a Markovian invasion he says is already coming.

Chuck has just killed himself, and only Jimmy will understand his own share of the blame. Gus now quietly owns Nacho, and a bedridden Hector has been left alive for a reason nobody outside Gus's head knows.

The Pierces have won — Tobias dead, Jefferson stepping down as Black Lightning, the family whole and the torch passing to Anissa, Jennifer and Grace. But under Tori Tower, Lala has just revived beside Tobias's corpse, laughing, the one loose thread no one knows is still pulling.

The pirates and Maroons have driven the Royal Navy off the beach, but Rogers still governs and Nassau is still contested. Vane is dead, Blackbeard has come back to war, and the name Long John Silver is spreading through the town without Silver's consent.
The Walrus is wrecked within sight of the Urca gold. Flint has killed his closest friend to keep the hunt alive, and Nassau's fort now flies Vane's colours.

flags.claim: Nassau's fort now flies Vane's colours
flags.evidence: Eleanor's situation changes when a small band of men take over Hornigold's fort and start sinking supply ships in the bay.
flags.correction: The fort is taken over by an unidentified small band of men, not explicitly Vane; Vane is described as making his way back to New Providence with his new crew.

results.cliff: Donnie's evidence is compromised, Axe knows Chuck lied about recusing, and Wendy is trapped between her husband and her boss. Chuck goes hunting for Axe personally, and the collision neither man can walk away from is finally here.
Weller has just arrested Jane, now revealed to be neither Taylor Shaw nor an innocent Jane Doe but a planted agent for a conspiracy she designed herself, led by an unknown figure named Shepherd.

Freeland is officially free, Odell in a cell and the ASA exposed to Congress. But Henderson is dead, Grace is in a coma, Lynn is quietly still on Green Light, and out in the shadows Lady Eve is rising with a mind-controlled Lala.

Roman dies leaving Jane his ZIP-cure clues, but the poisoning has already erased her — she wakes in the hospital married to Weller and secretly restored to her old Remi persona, delighted to be positioned to burn the team down. Zapata has flown off with Blake Crawford promising to 'change the world'.

Two years after Sandstorm's defeat, Jane has left Weller and the FBI to live with monks in the mountains. Weller arrives wearing a wedding ring, telling her Patterson, Reade and Zapata have all vanished — and a box only they can open lights her tattoos back up.

Jimmy has legally become 'Saul Goodman', and Kim just realized the man she loves has replaced himself with an alias. Lalo Salamanca has arrived in Albuquerque already suspicious of Werner's death and everything around Gus's operation.

Nassau is quiet on the surface: Rogers is finished in debt, Jack and Max hold the town through the Guthries, and Flint has left for Savannah. Silver has Madi back but has spent every alliance he had to buy her.
Nucky sits atop Atlantic City with Margaret at his side, unaware that his surrogate son, his own brother, and his aging mentor have just conspired to remove him.

The last ZIP bomb is disarmed in Times Square, Ivy is arrested, and the team walk into apparently happy futures — Jane and Weller fostering children, Patterson and Rich adventuring, Zapata raising her and Reade's daughter — but the finale keeps cutting to Jane being zipped into a body bag on the same Times Square block she was first found on, leaving whether any of the ending is real deliberately open.
Nucky has beaten the case, killed his surrogate son, and married Margaret to bury the evidence. He does not yet know she has quietly signed his most valuable land over to the Church.
Nucky has crushed Rosetti and reclaimed Atlantic City, but Margaret has walked out, Owen and Billie are dead, and his victory feels anonymous and hollow.

Nucky is dead on the boardwalk, killed by the boy his own past created. Luciano's Commission rules the underworld, Capone is bound for prison on tax charges, and the era of the boardwalk kings is over.
Flint returns to Nassau bound to Vane and hollowed out by Miranda's death. Rackham, once a joke, walks in with the Spanish fortune while Silver hides both his leg and his stake.

BoJack has finally landed the role he's chased his whole life, and Diane is on the film with him. But he asked her whether he's a good person and she wouldn't answer, and Herb is dying without ever having forgiven him.
Sarah Lynn is dead in BoJack's arms and nobody knows he was there. He tried to end his life on a desert highway and stopped only when he saw a herd of wild horses running alongside his car.

BoJack finally has a sibling he can love, but he's put his mother in a bad nursing home and about to lead a TV show designed to reflect his worst traits. Princess Carolyn is quietly grieving another lost pregnancy Ralph doesn't know about.

BoJack's face has been wiped out of his dream role, he's alone again after driving Wanda off, and Charlotte has banished him for what he almost did to her daughter. A polished publicist is now running his life toward an Oscar.

BoJack is alive, sober, and serving fourteen months in prison. The people he hurt have built lives around his absence. He sat on a roof with Diane one last time and admitted the point of life is that it's hard and you just keep going.
Chalky is a fugitive with his daughter dead and Narcisse still breathing — now Hoover's informant. Eli is on his way to Chicago, and Nucky's future lies in Cuban rum, not the boardwalk.

Bosch has handed in his badge to Billets after assaulting a superior officer. The real Delacroix killer is dead by Sam's hand — and Bosch's career and any real chance of time with Maddie hang unresolved.

BoJack has assaulted his costar on camera, and Diane has walked him into rehab rather than write about him. Mr. Peanutbutter is engaged to a woman he already cheated on; Princess Carolyn has a baby daughter she barely knows how to hold.
Veronica Allen has walked free for orchestrating her husband's murder. Irving is now interim Chief while grieving his only son, and Bosch's trail to his mother's killer has died with Fox Mitchell.

Bosch now knows the man who killed his mother is the sitting president of the police commission. Eleanor has quietly returned to LA as an FBI asset, and Edgar has realized Bosch bent the rules to close the Holland case.

Bosch has finally forced Walker to confess to both Elias's murder and his mother's, and buried Eleanor with Maddie in the desert. He's raising her alone now, still uneasy with Edgar and unsure who else in the department was helping Walker.

Bosch has caught the man behind Daisy Clayton but lost Elizabeth to grief. Irving is out of the mayoral race and politically wounded, and Edgar has just killed a man in what Bosch believes was murder, not self-defense.

Bosch has surrendered his badge after the LAPD helped the true killer walk free. Peña is dead but by a father's hand, not the law's. Maddie is applying to become the very kind of officer her father just quit being.

Butcher's entire crusade was built on Becca being dead. Homelander has just revealed she is alive, raising his superpowered son in secret — while the Pentagon has declared the Boys fugitives and Compound V a controlled substance.

Becca is dead by Ryan's own hand and the traumatised boy is now in CIA custody. Homelander is muzzled only by Maeve's airliner blackmail, and Hughie has just walked into a Congresswoman's office not knowing she is the secret head-popping assassin.

Homelander is now openly killing critics at rallies to public applause, with Ryan at his side. Neuman has been named Bob Singer's Vice-Presidential pick, Soldier Boy is in a government freezer, and Butcher has been told he has months to live.

Homelander now effectively rules America through his puppet President Calhoun, with martial law in force and most of the Boys jailed. Butcher has vanished with the Supe-killing virus and new tendril powers of his own, while Homelander has just been shown where a frozen Soldier Boy is being kept.

Madeline Burke has framed the team as terrorists, unleashed the Helios attack that has blacked out the Eastern Seaboard, and just called a drone strike on the Icelandic cottage sheltering Weller, Patterson and Zapata — with only Jane outside when it hits.

Homelander and Butcher are both dead — Butcher shot by Hughie to stop him unleashing a plague that would have killed every Supe on Earth. The Boys have disbanded: M.M. has adopted Ryan and remarried, Kimiko has moved to France, and Hughie and Annie are expecting a child.
Walt and Jesse have just watched Tuco beat his own man bloody for nothing. They are now his suppliers, at his mercy, and he is escalating.

Skyler has walked out with the kids after uncovering Walt's lies. Jane is dead by Walt's inaction, Jesse is in rehab, and burning wreckage from a plane crash indirectly caused by Walt is scattered across his back yard.

Walt lies dead in an Aryan Brotherhood meth lab, having killed Jack's crew to free Jesse, who drives off into the night. Skyler is destitute and holding the coordinates to Hank's grave as her only bargaining chip.
Jesse has just shot Gale on Walt's orders, buying Walt's life by making himself and Walt the only cooks Gus has left. War with Gus is now inevitable.

Walt has killed Gus and told Skyler he 'won'. But Jesse still doesn't know who really poisoned Brock, Hank never bought that Gus was the whole story, and a potted lily of the valley sits quietly in Walt's back yard.
Anthony has vowed to marry practically and without love, Eloise is still hunting Lady Whistledown, and — unknown to any character — Penelope Featherington holds the pen.

Penelope has publicly retired as Whistledown into a happy marriage, but the family is scattering — Francesca off to Scotland with Michaela, Eloise with them — and Benedict, the eldest single Bridgerton, remains uncommitted.

Joe Miller is in a cell awaiting trial for Danny's murder, having confessed to strangling the boy after grooming him. Ellie's marriage has collapsed, the Latimers are staring down a court case, and Hardy is leaving Broadchurch with the earlier Sandbrook killings still unsolved.
The Master is dead and the Hellmouth is quiet, but Buffy died for a moment during the fight, and the vampire hierarchy of Sunnydale has been left leaderless with the Anointed One still around.

The Mayor and Sunnydale High are rubble, Faith is in a coma no one expects her to wake from, and the class scatters — Cordelia and Wesley gone, Angel walking away without a goodbye, and Buffy standing in the ash of the only life she has ever had.

Bosch survived a coordinated attempt on his life and dismantled the Borders frame, but he now holds evidence that his own Chief tampered with a case file — and buried it. Edgar has just made lethal enemies inside his own department.
The trio have just met and united. Dracula's Night Creature army is still slaughtering Wallachia, and his castle can appear anywhere at nightfall.
Hector is magically enslaved to the Council of Sisters. Isaac has an army and a mirror pointing straight at Styria. Germain wanders the Infinite Corridor; Alucard is broken and dangerous.

The war is over. Trevor is back and Sypha is pregnant; Alucard has turned his father's castle into a refuge with Greta; and Dracula and Lisa are quietly alive again, hidden from everyone who knew them.
Benedict has married Sophie against every rule of the ton; Michaela has fled London the moment John was buried; and a new Lady Whistledown has taken up the pen.

Buffy has stabbed a re-souled Angel into a hell dimension and vanished from Sunnydale, leaving her friends without a Slayer, her mother knowing the truth for the first time, and Kendra dead in the library.

Jesus is about to step onto the mountain to deliver the largest sermon of his life to thousands, with Romans, Pharisees, and a hostile Sanhedrin faction all watching. John the Baptizer sits in Herod's prison, and a young apprentice named Judas has just introduced himself to the group.

The disciples have just watched Jesus command the sea itself, but Eden and Simon's marriage is broken, John the Baptizer still languishes in Herod's prison, and the Roman intelligence officer Atticus is now watching every move.

Jesus is riding into Jerusalem to crowds hailing him as Messiah, days before Passover. Caiaphas has already opened a formal Sanhedrin plot to kill him, Judas is skimming and scheming, and Ramah's father Kafni has sworn to move mountains to expose him.
Dracula is dead. Carmilla has fled to Styria with Hector enslaved to build her army; Isaac lives, planning revenge; Alucard has inherited an empty castle and unbearable grief.
Chuck was seconds from a civilian life; instead he stood over the shattered Intersect, chose to put a smarter version in his own head, and now has a body that knows kung fu it never trained for.

Jesus has openly declared himself Messiah to a Samaritan town, and Simon, Andrew, Matthew, Big James, and John have all thrown their old lives away to follow him. Nicodemus stayed behind in his position, and Shmuel is quietly building a case against Jesus for the Sanhedrin.
The Ring's leaders are captured and Shaw is beaten, but Chuck's father is dead, the Buy More is a smoking crater, and the Intersect 2.0 is still slowly cooking his brain.
The government has decided the Intersect is safer with Chuck buried in a bunker than living his life, and neither Sarah nor Casey has been given a choice about it.

flags.claim: the government has decided the Intersect is safer with Chuck buried in a bunker
flags.evidence: With Chuck's identity and life on the line, the CIA and NSA decide to have Chuck relocated to a permanent holding cell.
flags.correction: The decision is triggered by Chuck's identity/life being exposed to hostile surveillance, not a general safety judgment; the season ends on the decision to relocate him, framed as protection under threat.

results.cliff: Jesus has been arrested at Gethsemane after willingly submitting to his Father — his disciples have scattered, Judas has already kissed him for the guards, and Peter stands on the brink of the denial Jesus foretold at supper.

Chucky's Hackensack body is destroyed and Junior is dead, but Tiffany's Good Guy army survived the fight. She holds Andy at gunpoint in the truck, keeps a limbless Nica as prisoner, and an unidentified gloved figure is prowling the Wheelers' graves.

Jake, Devon and Lexy are trapped in marionette-doll bodies inside Wendell Wilkins' workshop while Chucky, Tiffany and Caroline drive off together as a family. Nica has just wheeled herself in — and Wendell is standing right behind her.

Johnny thought he could rebuild Cobra Kai his own way, but his students have already learned to fight dirty and his estranged son now trains under Daniel. And the man who created the original Cobra Kai has just walked back into his dojo.
Johnny and Daniel are finally training together, bound by a tournament bet that will decide Cobra Kai's fate. But Kreese has just called in reinforcements from a past Daniel barely survived once.
Miguel lies in a coma on life support, Johnny has thrown away his phone and disappeared into himself, Robby is on the run for what he did, and Cobra Kai belongs entirely to Kreese.

Kreese and Silver are dead, Cobra Kai has won the Sekai Taikai as Johnny's dojo, and he and Daniel are finally training the next generation of students together, in one combined style. The war Johnny reopened in season 1 is over.
Cobra Kai is publicly disgraced, Silver is in a cell, Carmen is carrying Johnny's child, and the two dojos have won. But Kreese, presumed dead in prison, has walked free without anyone knowing.
Fisk has blacked out New York, declared martial law, and imprisoned dissidents — including the Punisher — at Red Hook. Matt is publicly Daredevil again, quietly building a resistance of honest cops.
Benedict and Sophie are married against the ton's rules; Michaela has vanished the moment John was buried; and a new Lady Whistledown has taken up the pen.

flags.claim: Michaela has vanished the moment John was buried
flags.evidence: Francesca agrees with Michaela's idea to host a celebration of John's life. ... Francesca is stunned by Michaela's sudden departure.
flags.correction: Michaela remains present through the mourning period, helping Francesca plan a celebration of John's life; her sudden departure only happens later, at the end of the season during Queen Charlotte's ball.

results.cliff: Fisk is deposed and exiled after Matt unmasks in court, but Matt is then arrested for his own vigilante crimes. Heather has quietly put on Muse's mask, and Dex is now a CIA asset.

Kreese sits in a jail cell for a crime Silver committed. Silver owns Cobra Kai outright and is about to take it national. Miguel is on a bus to Mexico chasing a father he has never met, and Daniel is calling in his oldest ally from overseas.

Only characters whose existence did not depend on the loop remain, in a Winden with no time travel. At a dinner party a pregnant Hannah notices a yellow raincoat and feels a passing déjà vu, then says she has always liked the name Jonas.

Winden has been destroyed on schedule and Adam has murdered Martha to break the cycle. But a second Martha, from a parallel reality, has appeared to pull Jonas out — the story now has two worlds to close, not one.

Jonas has been thrown 33 years into a ruined future Winden, Mikkel is trapped as Michael in the past, and Ulrich is locked up in 1953. The wormhole under the town is real, and every attempt to shut it has fed it.

Mallus is dead, the Darhks are undone, and Amaya has gone home to Zambesi — but Nora Darhk has escaped Bureau custody with Ray's help, and Constantine has just told Sara that Mallus was not the only thing that got out.

The Dessens vanish through a corridor door into an unfamiliar reality, hunted by the ghosts of every Jason who wanted them. Leighton has followed them into the box, and in the progressive Chicago where Amanda stayed, Ryan is trying to synthesise the compound on his own.

Neron is dead, Ray is safe, and 2042 has been redeemed — but Zari Tomaz is gone, replaced by a brother only Nate remembers, and in Hell, Astra Logue has quietly kept sixteen damned souls back for herself.

The Time Masters are gone, Savage is dead, and the Legends have reinvented themselves as time's protectors — when a stranger from the future appears in his own Waverider and tells them they are all doomed.

The Legion is beaten and the Spear is gone, but the Legends have shattered history. Rip Hunter has walked away, Sara commands, and the Waverider lands in Los Angeles to find dinosaurs in the streets and buildings from every era jumbled together.

The alien invasion is over, but Mick is gone with Kayla, Constantine is damned to Hell again and walking his path alone, and a second Waverider has just materialised, destroyed the Legends' ship, and disappeared — leaving them stranded with no way home.

Ten years later, Sylvester's real mind has been restored, Rick and Beth are engaged, the Seven Soldiers have been freed, and Jay Garrick tells the Shade the JSA is needed again for adventures still to come.

The ISA is broken and Blue Valley has a moment of peace, but Cindy Burman has quietly claimed a black diamond housing a demon called Eclipso, and a man calling himself Starman has arrived in California looking for Pat.

flags.claim: a man calling himself Starman has arrived in California looking for Pat
flags.evidence: Meanwhile, Sylvester Pemberton looks for Pat in California.
flags.correction: The source names him Sylvester Pemberton, not 'Starman'; the name Starman is not used for him in this season's source.

results.cliff: Eclipso is beaten and Sylvester is back at the JSA's side, but the Crocks are on the front lawn as neighbours, Cameron is finding out he's an Icicle by blood, and the Helix Institute has decided the Blue Valley heroes are worth a visit.
Bullock has claimed the sheriff's badge and set himself opposite Al Swearengen as Deadwood braces for annexation, its lawless order suddenly having to answer to a lawman.

AI Gideon is dead, Gwyn's love is saved, and the Legends have a Waverider again — but Nate is permanently depowered, Sara is pregnant with a child inheriting her regenerative abilities, and Mike the Fixer's mysterious superiors have just arrested the entire crew on their own ship.
Hearst has left camp with Alma's claim in his pocket and his sheriff in Bullock's old chair, while Al scrubs Jen's blood off the Gem floor and lies to a grieving Johnny that she did not suffer.

Merritt is home and Lyle is dead, but the Leith Park ambush is still unsolved and its trail runs straight to Graham Finch's organisation. Carl has bought Department Q's future by holding Burns's corruption over his head, and James — now walking again — may be handed the case that nearly killed him.
Dexter has killed the only person who understood him and saved his sister in the process — but Doakes is now certain something is wrong with him and will not stop watching.
The Bay Harbor Butcher case is closed on the dead Doakes, Lila is dead in Paris, and Dexter is back with Rita — free, in a way he has never been before.
Deadwood is officially annexed and George Hearst is now living in it, having bought his way in. Bullock walks out of an empty Gem alone into a town that is no longer his to shape.
Chase is dead, Lumen is gone, and Debra has quietly picked her brother's side without knowing whose it was. Dexter is a single father again, and no one is closing the net.

Chucky, hiding inside a new Belle doll, ambushes Tiffany the moment she tries to swap souls into it — while Caroline watches and smiles. Nica has sworn revenge on Tiffany from New York, and no one else knows Chucky survived the boarding-school exorcism.
Arthur is dead but Rita is dead too, murdered while Dexter was killing him. Dexter is alone with three orphaned children, holding an infant in a pool of his mother's blood.
The Fates are undone, Behrad is alive, Charlie has moved on, and the Legends have their first quiet night in years — right up until aliens pluck Sara Lance out of London.
Debra has killed her captain to save her brother. She now carries a murder that no version of herself can survive, and Hannah is out there, alive.

Rudy — secretly the Ice Truck Killer — has infiltrated Dexter's life through Debra and killed his biological father, all to force Dexter to remember something buried in their shared past. Dexter's memories are only beginning to break the surface.

The team is tiny at Doom Manor, forced to reckon with the fact that Caulder — their savior — deliberately ruined their lives to extend his own life, so that he might protect his hidden daughter Dorothy.
Debra has walked in on Dexter killing Travis Marshall on an altar — the moment his cover, his family life, and her image of him all collapse in one instant.

Rita has forged the group into a mortal, imperfect superhero unit called Doom Force with Madame Rouge folded in; they aim time-travel and heroism at their future, though nothing in their bodies works right anymore.
Debra is dead, Vogel is dead, Saxon is dead. Dexter has faked his own death, left Harrison and Hannah behind in Argentina, and is living alone as a lumberjack in Oregon.

Bates has been arrested for Vera's murder days after secretly marrying Anna. Matthew refuses to reach for Mary, blaming himself for Lavinia's death, while Mary remains bound to Sir Richard's engagement — and to his grip on her Pamuk secret.

The Doom Patrol lies waxed over, Caulder is aged near death, Daddy-as-Miranda has hijacked Jane's body, and Dorothy stands alone in the yard against the Candlemaker as her long-absent mother Slava watches.
The Doom Patrol is dissolved, its members scattered — some dead, some in exile, some in the afterlife. The world moves on without them, and each of them has, at last, chosen how their story ends.

Downton is saved by Lavinia's father's legacy and now has joint masters in Robert and Matthew, with Tom installed as the estate's agent — but Sybil is dead, and the family is still learning to hold together around her absence.
Dexter is married, expecting a child, and clear of the Skinner and Miguel; his secret has survived his first real friendship, and nobody is looking at him.

flags.claim: nobody is looking at him
flags.evidence: After killing Miguel and framing The Skinner, Dexter is targeted by Ramon.
flags.correction: Ramon Prado is targeting Dexter at season's end, suspicious over Miguel's death; the source does not show this resolved.

results.cliff: Green is dead in a Piccadilly road accident days after Mary had him dismissed. Bates's alibi is vague and Anna is left in silent dread. A mile from the house, Edith's daughter Marigold is being raised as a farmer's ward.

Mary has married Henry Talbot; Anna and Bates are expecting; Thomas has been pulled back from suicide and restored. Bertie has walked away from Edith over Marigold, though the sisters have reconciled — his return is left an open question.
Polo has walked free and returned to Las Encinas, hated by everyone but untouchable. Cayetana is sitting on the murder weapon — and knows exactly what she has.
Polo is dead, ruled a suicide only because everyone lied. Nadia and Lu leave for New York with Malick; Samuel, Guzmán, Rebeka, Ander and Omar return to Las Encinas for their final year.
Kenny has ditched April at a gas station and driven off into the night, too proud to admit the Tampa deal fell through. Everyone he left behind still believes he is on his way to the majors.
Armando's body is at the bottom of the lake, shared secret of Samuel, Rebe and Guzmán. Ari and Samuel are officially together, and both Guzmán and Ander are gone.
Iván is fighting for his life after a serious accident. Cruz is dead, Patrick is alone, and Dídac and Isadora are quietly becoming something more.

Mary loves Matthew but has not accepted him, terrified he will discover Pamuk. He plans to leave Downton just as Britain declares war on Germany, and Cora has lost the son who would have secured the estate.
Martín is under arrest, Raúl is dead and Isadora refuses to take Dídac back after his betrayal. Carmen killed Raúl to save Chloe, and Dalmar is sitting on the video, unsure what to do with it.

Emily has slept with her closest Paris friend's boyfriend on what was supposed to be his last night in the city — but Antoine's investment has just kept Gabriel downstairs. Camille suspects nothing, and Mathieu Cadault is quietly courting Emily.

Camille has publicly outed Gabriel's love for Emily at their own altar, Alfie has broken up with Emily suspecting exactly that, and Gabriel has just told Emily that Camille came back from Greece pregnant with his child.
Nano is in a cell for a murder Polo committed. Only Polo, Carla and Christian know the truth; Samuel is left grieving Marina and certain the wrong man is going down.

Emily is running the new Agence Grateau office in Rome and touring the city on the back of Marcello's scooter, while a Michelin-starred, Camille-less Gabriel is asking Mindy exactly where in Rome he can find her.

Emily is back in Paris and single, Sylvie's agency is only alive because Princess Jane has bought her way in, Mindy is engaged to Nico just as Alfie realises he loves her — and a postcard from a yacht in Greece is asking Emily to come find Gabriel.

Lucious has been arrested at his legacy concert and blames Cookie for turning him in — unaware his real accuser was Vernon, whose body Andre and Rhonda are hiding after she killed him. Cookie, Andre, Hakeem and Anika are moving to seize Empire while he sits in a cell.

Sylvie's team has walked out of Savoir with Pierre Cadault in tow and wants Emily on board rather than back in Chicago with Madeline. Meanwhile Gabriel and Camille have moved in together, one floor below Emily and Alfie.

Anna has been arrested for the very murder Bates was cleared of. Robert now privately knows Edith's ward Marigold is his own grandchild, but has said nothing. Rose has married Atticus and moved out of the family.

Ashtray is dead, Fezco is under arrest, Cal is in custody, and the Cassie–Maddy–Nate friendship is finished. Rue is tentatively sober but Jules is standing alone crying after Rue walked away from her in silence.

At Hakeem's wedding, Lucious has just married Anika — pregnant with Hakeem's baby — to stop her testifying against him. Rhonda, now certain Anika pushed her down the stairs, cornered her on a balcony, and one of them went over.

James sprints across the beach with Leslie's shotgun, drawing armed police away from Alyssa so she cannot be charged. A single gunshot fires as the screen cuts to black; whether he is alive is left unsaid.

Rue is dead of an overdose Alamo arranged, Nate is dead in the ground, Laurie has hanged herself, and Ali has shot Alamo in his own club. Cassie, Maddy and Jules are left to figure out what a life without any of them looks like.

Eros is quarantined but alive, an entire station rewritten by an alien substance no one on Earth or Mars actually controls. Avasarala knows the UN itself is compromised, and Holden's ragged crew are the only outsiders who have seen what happened there.
An alien network to 1300 habitable systems has just switched on, and the Rocinante is the first ship through the gate. The Earth-Mars-Belt war is on hold and no political body owns what happens next.

Samu is dead by Benjamin's hand, and Benjamin is finally under arrest. Isadora's rape case is heading to trial, Iván has just come out and reconciled with his father Cruz, and the Commerford siblings are learning to live without their father.

Rue is high and alone after Jules leaves her at the train station. Maddy has stolen the sex tape of Cal and Jules, and Nate has just been publicly humiliated by his father — the Jacobs household is a live wire.

Earth is broken, Alex is dead, Mars is fracturing, and Marco Inaros holds the gate to 1300 worlds. Avasarala is back in charge with the Rocinante as her cudgel, but the Free Navy has already taken the piece of the board that matters most.

Mao is still at large but the protomolecule is loose everywhere at once — on Venus, on Tycho with Fred Johnson, and inside living Belter children being kept in stasis on Io. Everyone has a piece and nobody has control.
The Boston structure is destroyed, but Tom has voluntarily boarded an Overlord's shuttle with Karen to spare Ben, leaving Weaver standing in the street watching him go.

Four factions converge on New Vegas: the Legion marches on the Strip under a new Caesar, the Enclave has activated Phase 2 from inside Vault 32, RobCo's Robert House is revealed alive in the Lucky 38, and the Brotherhood's Quintus now holds Liberty Prime blueprints.

Lucy leaves the ruins of Los Angeles with the Ghoul and Dogmeat, chasing Hank across the wasteland toward New Vegas, while Norm is trapped underground with the frozen executives who really run the vaults.

The Gerhardts are gone and Kansas City has swallowed North Dakota, but Hanzee has just been handed a fresh identity by a man in a park, and Mike Milligan has been folded into a corporate hierarchy that has no idea what it has hired.
Gloria and Varga sit across a plain interview table: she tells him he is going to prison, he tells her a limo is coming for him. Neither speaks again. The scene ends without an answer.

Marco is dead and the Belt has its independence, but the Ring gates still lead to a Laconian empire the Inner powers have never met. Filip is loose somewhere in the Belt, the entities that ate Marco are still eating passing ships, and the Rocinante has traded a war for a much larger unanswered question.

The protomolecule fight on Ilus is over, but a Belter warlord no one is watching has bought Martian stealth on the black market and thrown asteroids at Earth. The one person who saw it coming has just been ejected from power.

Kansas City has been folded into Ebal Violante's modernised operation, half the Cannon Limited's business now under Italian control. Loy is dead on his own front step; his surviving son Satchel — who grows up to become Mike Milligan — has just watched him die.

The Lyon kitchen is quiet. Munch has eaten a biscuit given without expectation of repayment, and something in him has broken open. Everyone else at the table — Dot, Wayne, Scotty — is just having dinner.

Travis, Madison and Alicia are following Alejandro's dying instructions toward the border to look for Nick, who has just been captured with Luciana by an unidentified armed group. Strand has stayed behind at the hotel, and Daniel is presumed dead in the compound fire.

Malvo and Lester are both dead and Molly and Gus have their family, but Malvo unlocked the handcuffs of the hitman Mr. Wrench and told him to avenge his partner, and Molly is about to inherit a chief's badge she never went looking for.
Morgan has been shot and left to die by Virginia. The rest of the group is separated across Pioneer settlements under her rule, and a pregnant Grace is with them.
The dam is destroyed and the group is scattered. Madison swims to shore alone with no sign of Nick, Alicia, Strand or Daniel, and no home left to return to.
Madison and Nick are dead. Alicia, Strand and Luciana have folded into Morgan's crew and are operating out of a denim factory in Texas, dedicated to leaving supplies for anyone who needs them.
Barry has run into a black hole above Central City; Eddie is dead by his own hand to erase Thawne, and Iris now knows Barry is the Flash.

Morgan has met Madison alive on a Louisiana beach and both are being taken blindfolded to the mysterious PADRE, which has just seized baby Mo. Alicia is quietly alive but hidden from everyone she loves.
Undone by Zoom's murder of Henry, Barry has run back in time and prevented Eobard Thawne from killing Nora — knowingly rewriting history.
Barry has surrendered himself to the Speed Force prison to atone for Flashpoint, leaving Iris and the team to protect Central City without him.
DeVoe is dead and the team is celebrating, when a mystery woman reveals herself as Nora — Barry and Iris's future daughter — and confesses she has made 'a big mistake.'
Nora has been erased from history, Thawne has regained his powers in 2049, and the future newspaper has moved the coming Crisis up to December 10, 2019.

Nuclear warheads have detonated across Texas. Morgan and Grace are hiding under a vehicle with baby Mo; Alicia is locked in Teddy's bunker; Strand is sheltered elsewhere; and Daniel is being airlifted out with the others.
The Godspeed clone war is won and August Heart is imprisoned; Barry and Iris have renewed their vows with Bart and Nora at their side.
The families are on Strand's yacht with Los Angeles burning behind them. Travis has just shot Liza on the beach after her bite, and no one aboard knows Strand or where he plans to take them.

flags.claim: no one aboard knows Strand
flags.evidence: In a military cell, Strand bribes a guardsman to save feverish Nick from being moved. ... Strand recruits Nick for an escape plot.
flags.correction: Nick has been in a cell with Strand, was saved by him, and was recruited into his escape plot — Nick knows Strand by the time they reach the beach.

results.cliff: Thawne is destroyed for good and Iris is cured, but Frost is dead — leaving Caitlin and Mark grieving — and Caitlin's Consciousness Resurrection Chamber has produced a new Frost claiming to be 'a friend.'
Barry has expanded the speedster roster while continuing as The Flash; Eddie is at peace; Khione has ascended to protect the natural order; and Nora is born.
Barry is nearly powerless as he races to build an artificial Speed Force; Iris has vanished from within the Mirrorverse; and Eva is loose in the real world.

Madison, Alicia and Troy's daughter Tracy set out for Los Angeles to rebuild, keeping their survival secret from almost everyone. PADRE has been renamed MADRE in Madison's honour and the rest of the group have scattered to build their own communities.
The Baldwins have buried their son and Gordo has been silently shattered, yet a decade on both Jamestown and the Cold War have only grown, with plutonium now flying to the Moon.

Nuclear war has been averted and Jamestown rebuilds, but Gordo and Tracy are dead, Karen has slept with their son Danny, the KGB still holds Margo through Sergei, and by 1995 boots are already on Mars.
Karen and Molly are dead, Danny is broken and exiled on Mars, Kelly is raising a newborn son by the late Alexei, and Margo — the head of NASA — has secretly vanished into the USSR.
Mars is a free world at last, but bought at the cost of Ed, Kelly, and thousands of lives — and eight years later, the wreck of a lost Soviet mission has quietly powered itself back on.

The Foundation has survived its first crisis, but Hari's plan needs a Second Foundation that Gaal was meant to lead. Gaal and the daughter she never knew, Salvor, are together on Synnax with the Prime Radiant, while on Trantor a Cleon dynasty already sabotaged from within rules an Empire it can no longer see clearly.

Olivia has crossed to a parallel universe to meet a still-living William Bell in a New York where the Twin Towers still stand — while, back home, Walter has just visited the grave of a Peter Bishop who died as a boy in 1985.

The Mule is not the man Gaal killed — she is Bayta Mallow, still alive and still hunting Gaal. Trantor now belongs to Dusk alone, ruling as Brother Darkness with the Prime Radiant. And a robot head recovered on Mycogen has just sent a clasping signal to Kalle, hidden with other robots on Earth's Moon.
The Olivia who came home from the parallel universe is not Olivia — it is her alternate, Fauxlivia, quietly embedded beside Peter. The real Olivia sits in a detention cell under Walternate's eye.
Peter has forced the two universes to sit at the same table but has been written out of time in the process; neither Walter nor either Olivia remembers he ever existed.

Terminus is destroyed but its people have been pulled inside Hari's Vault. Salvor is dead, Gaal and Hari are asleep, and Demerzel now rules Trantor alone through a fresh set of Cleons and the Prime Radiant. Sareth and Dawn have fled with an unborn heir, and 152 years ahead, a Mentalic called the Mule has just registered Gaal's existence.
Boyd is trapped underground after Sara pushed him into a farway tree. Tabitha has fallen into the cavern where the creatures sleep, and a bus of new arrivals just pulled into town at nightfall.

Mars kept its stolen asteroid and by 2012 has become an economic linchpin, but Margo is in a US prison, Sergei is dead by Irina's hand, and Kuznetsov Station now dominates a much bigger colony no one on Earth can quite control.

Jim is dead. Tabitha and Jade know they are reincarnations of Miranda and Christopher — the pair who failed to save the sacrificed children in a past life. Fatima has given birth and the Kimono Woman has vanished with the amniotic sac.

Ned Stark is dead and the Seven Kingdoms are fracturing. Robb marches south as King in the North, Robert's brothers Stannis and Renly stir their own claims, and across the sea Daenerys walks out of a fire holding three baby dragons.

The bottle tree is down and darkness has fallen in the middle of the day. Every talisman in the town has been thrown into a farway tree by Sophia, and Fatima has become one of the creatures to get everyone else out.

The plan works: Michael is delivered to 2167, the Observer invasion never happens, and the family finds itself back in an unspoiled 2015. Walter, who travelled forward with Michael in September's place, is gone — and has sent Peter a drawing of a white tulip as farewell.

Tabitha is alive in a hospital in the outside world, days after the Boy in White shoved her from the lighthouse tower — proof there is a way out, though not one she chose or understands. The music box is destroyed, but the Boy in White told her 'this is the only way.'

Robb has won every battle but has just insulted the ally who controls his only bridge home. Winterfell is in ashes, Bran and Rickon are presumed dead, and north of the Wall Sam has watched an army of the dead march past a hiding rock.

Daenerys is finally sailing for Westeros with dragons and armies. Cersei sits on a throne built on the ashes of her enemies and her last surviving child, while Jon holds a united North and Bran sees history from beyond the Wall.

Jon lies dead in the snow. Sansa and Theon have leapt from Winterfell into unknown drifts, Daenerys has been carried off by Drogon and captured by a Dothraki horde, and Cersei walks free with a reanimated Mountain at her back.

The prime universe stands alone again and Bell has been beaten — but twenty-one years on, the Observers have conquered Earth, and the ambered Fringe team is only now waking into an occupied world where Peter and Olivia's grown daughter Etta is fighting the resistance.

Tywin is dead and Tyrion is a fugitive across the sea. Cersei's grip on her weak new son-king Tommen is shaky, Sansa is hidden away in the Vale as Littlefinger's protégée, and beyond the Wall Bran is being fed to weirwood roots.

The war is over. Bran the Broken rules the Six Kingdoms from a ruined King's Landing with Tyrion as his Hand; Sansa reigns as Queen in an independent North; Jon lives with the Wildlings beyond the Wall; and Arya has sailed off the western edge of every known map.
The Wall has fallen. The Night King rides a dead dragon into the Seven Kingdoms, and the two Targaryen lovers marching to meet him do not yet know that Jon is the true heir and Daenerys's own nephew.

The trial is nearing its verdict with Austin's perjury as the most dramatic testimony the jury has heard — Georgia's freedom now depends on a lie her ten-year-old son has just told under oath, framing his own abusive father.

Georgia has been arrested at her own wedding reception for the murder of Tom Fuller. Austin, the only person who actually saw it happen, insists he told no one — meaning somebody else has moved against her, and Paul has been married to her for a matter of hours.

Aziraphale has gone back to Heaven, promoted by the Metatron to organise a Second Coming and convinced he can reform the institution from within. Crowley is on Earth alone for the first time in six thousand years, rejected after finally confessing.

Armageddon has been called off and both Heaven and Hell have quietly withdrawn, afraid of what Aziraphale and Crowley have become. For the first time in six thousand years the pair belong to no side but each other.
The neighborhood has been reset and every human memory wiped. All that survives of the truth is a scrap of paper Janet hands Eleanor reading 'Find Chidi.'
The four humans have failed Judge Gen's tests and are seconds from being sent to the Bad Place. Michael and Janet just arrived — with no obvious card left to play.
A fresh experimental neighborhood has just gone live with four new human subjects. Michael, its architect, is folding under his first-ever panic attack as the first subject wakes.
Cobblepot has crowned himself king of Gotham's underworld. In the ruins of the mob war, Bruce is about to descend a hidden stairwell in his father's study, chasing a life Thomas Wayne kept from him.
The Good Place has been rebuilt into a system where souls can finally leave, and the group has begun saying goodbye to each other one by one at the door.

House Stark has been shattered. Robb and Catelyn are dead, Bran and Rickon are gone north, Sansa is married to a Lannister and Arya is on a road with the Hound. The Boltons rule the North for Tywin, and beyond the Wall the Wildlings are almost at Castle Black.
Bruce has taken up a mask to fight for Gotham, and Ra's al Ghul is alive and watching him. Cobblepot has Ed Nygma frozen and displayed as a trophy inside his new Iceberg Lounge.

Jeremiah's bombs have cut Gotham off from the mainland and reduced it to lawless boroughs. Bruce accepts his destiny as the city's protector; Gordon lights a searchlight over GCPD Headquarters as a beacon in the dark.
Catherine has just fired the starting gun on a coup she cannot recall, knowing Leo is Peter's prisoner and Marial has betrayed her — all while carrying Peter's unborn child.

Peter is dead, the rebellion is crushed and Catherine finally rules with the confidence of an empress — but Archie has been secretly revived by Marial, Paul is still an infant, and the court around her is thinned and wary.

Catherine sits on the throne surrounded by friends she has just arrested, married to a man she has just tried to murder — who is very much alive because he swapped in a body double, Pugachev, whose body now cools on the floor.

Ten years after No Man's Land, Bruce is back as a bat-masked vigilante and Gordon calls him in with a signal in the night sky. Cobblepot and Nygma have escaped custody again, and Jeremiah is loose after faking his brain-death.

Hugo Strange is in FBI custody but his Indian Hill experiments — including a resurrected Fish Mooney and a boy who is Bruce Wayne's exact double — are loose in Gotham. Gordon leaves the badge behind to find Lee.

Deborah defied Bob Lipka's NDA and played to 30,000 in Central Park after he tried to bury her. Ava has her own pilot, Jimmy is in the Latitude mailroom, and Deborah has never been bigger — or had a bigger enemy.

A pregnant June is loaded into a black van at Nick's urging, its purpose — Mayday rescue or Eye punishment — unknown. Serena's threats hang over Hannah, and Rita is now sitting on a hidden bundle of Jezebels letters that document Gilead's atrocities.
Cortana has taken control of John's body and flown Silver Team out with both keystones. Kai's question of whether the man inside the armor is still John goes unanswered.

John is finally on Halo with Cortana back in hand, but Makee has walked into a Forerunner structure intent on using the ring to 'sterilise' the galaxy, and a Monitor has just told him something worse is buried deeper inside.

Paul has just won re-election, unaware his new fiancée has embezzled from him, burned her dead husband into his fireworks, and had her children flee on the back of a motorcycle. Cynthia has proof of the money, Gabriel has proof of the murder, and Ginny is somewhere on the road with Austin.

The show is #1 and Deborah has just gotten a network exec fired with a single phone call to her old affair Bob Lipka. She's more powerful than she has ever been, and more indebted to a man who can undo her.

Ava has just blackmailed Deborah into the head writer job by threatening to leak her affair with Bob Lipka. Deborah, who never loses, now has to walk into a writers' room across from someone who just bested her.
Fred is dead in the woods; his ring finger is in Serena's mail. June arrived home covered in blood and Luke has seen for the first time what she is now willing to do. Hannah is somewhere in Gilead.

Boston is liberated but Gilead is not gone. Hannah is still on the other side of the wall. June sits in her old room at the Waterford house and begins to record her story as Offred, while Luke fights on with Mayday.

flags.claim: Hannah is still on the other side of the wall.
flags.evidence: The source for season 6 never mentions Hannah.
flags.correction: Hannah is not referenced anywhere in the season 6 source summaries.

results.cliff: Emily is driving baby Nichole toward the Canadian border while June walks back into Gilead. Serena has crossed a line she cannot uncross by letting them go, and Nick has been left behind with nothing.

flags.claim: Emily is driving baby Nichole toward the Canadian border
flags.evidence: June is reunited with Emily, who is dropped off at the escape truck by Lawrence. Instead of escaping with them, June hands Holly to Emily, telling her to call her Nichole.
flags.correction: Emily is not driving; she is a passenger in the escape truck (dropped off by Lawrence) when June hands her the baby and tells her to call her Nichole.

results.cliff: June and Serena, each with an infant and each a fugitive, ride the same Vancouver-bound train, no longer certain who is hunting them and who is helping. Luke is in Canadian police custody; Nick is playing both sides.

flags.claim: Luke is in Canadian police custody
flags.evidence: While in the queue at the train station, the two see police checking documents. Realizing June and Nichole cannot get to safety with him, Luke stays behind and is arrested while they board the train.
flags.correction: Luke is arrested by Toronto police at the train station for beating the driver who attacked June to death; he is in Canadian police custody, which matches — but note the arrest is specifically for the killing, not a general detention.

results.cliff: Hannibal has walked away from a bloodbath in his own kitchen and disappeared into Europe with Bedelia at his side. Will, Jack, Alana, and a secretly-alive Abigail lie bleeding on his floor.

Will and Hannibal have gone over the cliff together after killing the Red Dragon, and no bodies have been recovered. Bedelia sits alone at a table set for three, one of her own cooked legs on it, waiting to see who comes through the door.

Gotham is a smoking ruin, Batman has disappeared into the debris, and a mysteriously 'normal' Joker just crawled out of the vat that was meant to end him. Harley, Ivy, and the crew are alive but standing in the wreckage with no allies and no plan.

Harley and Ivy are together and speeding out of Gotham as Gordon rages behind them, a jilted Kite Man watches the wreckage, and a fully restored Joker is loose in the city. Nothing about their new relationship has been tested outside the getaway car.
Children including baby Nichole are on Canadian soil. Both Waterfords sit in Canadian detention, each having betrayed the other. June is bleeding out in the woods, carried away by her handmaids.

The Sirens have just formed and Harley has finally accepted both halves of herself, but Nightwing's grave is empty and only Talia knows he's alive again in a Lazarus Pit. Batgirl is paralysed, Bruce is Batman again, and the villain corporate order lies in rubble.

Metropolis is restored and physically relocated next to Gotham; the Luthors are shrunk inside Frankette, Brainiac is dead, and Harley and Ivy have reaffirmed their love. They head off into the night for whatever's next.

Harley is a full Bat Family member and Ivy is about to walk into the Legion of Doom's top office — hero and villain, living together, for the first time. Bruce has surrendered himself to Joker's new GCPD.

Nick is fully out and their relationship is public and steady, but Charlie has just admitted to a history of self-harm and is walking home with an unsent 'I love you' on his phone. Nick has asked to be told when Charlie is stressed, and Charlie has promised.

Heaven has officially ended the Exterminations and agreed to receive redeemed sinners, but Angel Dust has walked back into Valentino's arms out of guilt, Valentino now runs the Vees over a decapitated Vox, and Lilith has finally returned Charlie's call after seven years of silence.

The hotel stands rebuilt and a sinner has provably reached Heaven, but Alastor is still bound to someone, Charlie's mother Lilith has been coerced by Lute into returning to shut the hotel down, and the Vees are gathering to take Hell for themselves.

Charlie is months into recovery, sleeping over at Nick's, and the couple has crossed every intimacy threshold together. But sixth form is ending, Nick is leaning toward Leeds, and Charlie still has another year of school ahead.
Peter is airborne in Nathan's arms, seconds from detonating over Manhattan. Sylar lies impaled but unseen, and Hiro has disappeared into 1671 Japan.

Ricky and Nini have finally reconciled — just as she accepts a spot at a Denver arts school starting in a month. Big Red and Ashlyn have just kissed, Miss Jenn is quietly falling for Ricky's dad, and Gina has left again.
EJ and Gina have just started something; Ricky is warming to Lily, unaware she stole his harness on show night; Nini is chasing music as 'Nina' and Mr. Mazzara is leaving for Caltech.

The documentary has just aired. Ricky and Gina have kissed, EJ is blindsided by their hidden feelings, and Ashlyn is processing both her own feelings for another girl at camp and the reveal that Big Red is bisexual.

The senior musical is done. Ricky and Gina have said 'I love you' with her film moving to Salt Lake to keep them close; Ashlyn and Maddox are together; Miss Jenn is staying at East High and heading to New Zealand with Mr. Mazzara; EJ is being pushed toward teaching.

Lyra has walked out of her own world clutching the alethiometer, chasing a father who has just torn a hole in the sky to fight God. A boy from a third world has fallen through his own portal, and her mother is still hunting her.

The war is won and the Authority is dead, but the Subtle Knife is broken and every window between worlds is sealed. Lyra is back in Jordan College and Will back with his mother, each sworn to sit alone in their own Oxford Botanic Garden every midsummer's day, unable ever to cross to the other.

Nick and Charlie are a couple, and Nick has just come out to his mum with plans to tell their friends. His rugby mates, brother, father and the wider school still don't know, and Charlie's history with Ben has left scars neither has really talked about.

Will Graham is locked in the Baltimore State Hospital, framed as the Copycat killer and the man who murdered and ate Abigail Hobbs. Hannibal Lecter walks free, still consulting for the FBI, and no one but Will knows what he really is.

Haqqani is off the CIA's kill list, protected by Dar and quietly Saul. Quinn has vanished into Syria believing Carrie rejected him. Islamabad station has been gutted and the U.S. asset list is in Taliban hands.

Langley is in ruins with 200 dead and its leadership gone. Brody, framed for a bombing he did not commit, is loose in Canada. Saul has inherited the Agency, and whoever engineered the attack is unknown.
Brody is dead and Carrie has his daughter and a station-chief posting in Istanbul. Saul has been pushed out of the CIA by Lockhart, but his Iran regime-change gamble is quietly working.

Quinn lies in a coma from a brain hemorrhage after the sarin attack. Carrie has ended things with Jonas and is holding a farewell letter from Quinn she has not opened. Saul is publicly whole but privately gutted.
The war is averted and Anna is dead. Carrie lives openly with Yevgeny in Moscow, publicly a defector — but privately Saul's new Russian asset, filing intelligence through Anna's own tradecraft.
Keane has survived assassination and taken office, but Carrie watches her jail Saul and dozens of other officials without cause. Quinn is dead. The alliance that put Keane in power has just broken.
Rhaenyra has just learned that Aemond killed her son Luke on Vhagar. Both sides now command dragons, armies are gathering, and neither faction can climb down.
Frank is the 46th President without a single vote cast for him; Doug lies badly injured in the woods and Rachel is somewhere on the run.
Frank has the vice presidency he schemed for, but three journalists are one step from proving he had Congressman Russo killed.
Frank has just won the Iowa caucuses, but Claire has walked out of the marriage that built his power.

Coulter has vanished with a drugged Lyra, and Will has the Subtle Knife but no idea where either of them are. Asriel is gathering angels and armies for open war against the Authority, and Cardinal MacPhail now knows Lyra is prophesied to bring a new Fall.

Keane has resigned despite being reinstated. Carrie has been returned from a Russian black site after seven months without medication, in bipolar delirium, unable to remember what she gave up in that cell.
Claire is President and Frank is out in the cold expecting a pardon that is not coming; she is planning a war in Syria alone.
The Underwoods have chosen to run on live terror; ICO has just executed a hostage on video and Tom Hammerschmidt has begun tracing Frank's earliest murders.

Rebecca is dead in Annalise's basement. Annalise and Frank each ask the other 'did you do it?' and neither believes the answer, while the four students remain bound to Annalise by Sam's murder and know none of it.

Brody is congressman-elect and al-Qaeda's freshly-installed mole; he has killed Walker for Nazir and answers to him. Carrie, discredited and off medication, is going under for ECT holding the only clue anyone has.
Wes has just watched his real father executed on the street. Frank has vanished with a suitcase of Mahoney cash, and no one knows who ordered Wallace's hit or what Frank will do next.
Wes is dead, and Annalise has traced the Mahoney family to his killing. Laurel is pregnant with Wes's child and has just been ambushed in the street by his killer.
Rhaenyra now commands four war-dragons to Aemond's one, Aegon lies burned and comatose in the Red Keep, and armies from the Reach, the North, and the Riverlands are on the march.

flags.claim: Aegon lies burned and comatose in the Red Keep
flags.evidence: Aegon, slowly recovering, tells Aemond he remembers nothing about the battle.
flags.correction: By season's end Aegon has come out of the coma and is recovering — conscious enough to speak with Aemond in E6, and by E8 Larys is proposing he and Aegon flee together to Braavos.

results.cliff: Jorge is behind bars but his empire is intact. Nate has found a file hinting an unnamed child presumed dead may still be alive, and a stranger named Gabriel Maddox has just walked into Middleton with an agenda no one understands.

Nolan has fled Earth after nearly beating his own son to death, revealing himself as a Viltrumite conqueror. Debbie's marriage was a lie, Chicago lies in ruins, and Allen has warned that the empire will not simply let this go.

Bonnie and Nate murdered an innocent man to avenge a killing they misread. Emmett is on the floor of his office gasping for air, Laurel has vanished with her son, and the Governor and Castillos are still moving pieces around Annalise.
A mass zombie outbreak just tore through Max Rager, and Vivian Stoll's arriving mercenaries have revealed themselves as an all-zombie army planning to make Seattle a zombie haven.

The Coalition has broken Viltrum but not the Viltrumites. Thragg has told Mark the remaining pure-bloods now live secretly among humans as breeding stock, and Allen holds a virus that could kill them all — and possibly every human alive alongside them.

Angstrom's assault has left Rex dead and Earth's hero ranks gutted, an unconscious Conquest sits in a secret GDA cell, and Mark has just told Oliver that killing is now on the table. Meanwhile Angstrom has been fully healed and is plotting his next move with the Technicians, and mysterious aliens have taken Battle Beast.
Newborn Mateo has just been kidnapped from the hospital nursery. A nurse handed him to Rose — the crime lord Sin Rostro — who has driven off with the baby.
The war is over: Blaine is dead, Enzo is dead, the cure is real, and ten years on Liv and Major have found a way for their found family to stay together on Zombie Island.
Claire has killed Doug alone in the Oval Office while carrying Frank's unborn heir; every outside witness to the Underwoods is dead.

flags.claim: every outside witness to the Underwoods is dead
flags.evidence: Doug provides information about Rachel's whereabouts to Janine.
flags.correction: Journalist Janine Skorsky, who has been investigating the Underwoods with Hammerschmidt, is still alive at season's end and has just received information from Doug about Rachel's burial location.

results.cliff: The story ends here. Jane and Rafael are married, Rose is dead, Petra and J.R. are back together, and the narrator has revealed himself as a grown Mateo, telling the story that becomes the telenovela.
Rafael was on the verge of proposing to Jane when a call from Rose in prison stopped him. In a shocking twist, he reveals the reason to Jane.
Ava is jailed for murder and facing a long sentence. Arlo is dead in prison. Boyd is engaged to a woman he cannot reach and about to move heroin for Wynn Duffy.

Mags is dead by her own hand, the Bennett empire in ruins, and Dickie survives in prison plotting revenge. Winona carries Raylan's child, and Arlo, broken by Helen's murder, has no reason left to steady himself.

Ava has been quietly released to inform on Boyd, who has no idea. Raylan's transfer to Miami is approved — but he is staying for one last case, the RICO case being built around the man who dug coal with him.

Boyd preaches to a prison congregation, believing Ava dead. Ava lives quietly in California with Boyd's son. Raylan is back in Miami with Winona and Willa, separated but present — the debt he and Boyd carry from a Harlan coal mine closed with the truth withheld.
Monty is dead, Tommy is about to become president of M-Tex, and he owes Gallino his life. Cooper has quietly bought up leases whose value no one yet knows.

Wessex holds its peace and Uhtred is once again Alfred's warlord in name and deed. But Aethelflaed comes home ruined by love and marriage, Alfred is visibly ageing, and the Danes still watch from the north.

Wessex is saved, Guthrum baptised, and Uhtred's debt to Alfred is paid. He rides north with Hild toward the fortress his uncle still holds, while Ragnar the Younger and Brida are sent to the Danes as hostages of the new peace.
Michael has just been shot moments after his and Jane's wedding, and Petra's identical twin Anezka has drugged her to take her place — nobody yet knows either has happened.

Eve has stabbed Villanelle in her own bed after they both admitted the obsession was mutual. Villanelle is alive, wounded, unaccounted for, and no longer being handled by Konstantin — who she was last ordered to kill.

Tandy has been banished from Tucson under threat of death; he and Carol are together on the open road with no destination. Meanwhile, Tandy's brother Mike is alive and completely alone on the International Space Station.

Tommy has taken his loyalists and his son out of M-Tex to run a rival oil outfit funded entirely by cartel money. Cami is left holding a debt-drowning M-Tex and a Gulf rig on a coin-flip, and Gallino has warned Tommy that if CTT fails he will take what Tommy loves most.
The group is on a yacht fleeing a nuclear meltdown, just saved from a returning Pat Brown by a wealthy stranger, Pamela Brinton, whom none of them have ever met.
Peace holds by a thread — Stiorra now rules the north beside a Danish king Uhtred trusts, and Edward's son Aethelstan grows up under Uhtred's sword. Somewhere, a caged Brida is still coming for him.
After years of thinking they were among the last people alive, Tandy's small found family — settled at a quiet Mexican homestead — is surrounded by 94 survivors emerging from an underground bunker.

Ellie's revenge tour has cost Jesse's life, Tommy's wounds and her own conscience, and Abby has her at gunpoint in the theater as a shot rings out. The show then rewinds three days to Abby's morning, signalling a full switch of perspective.
