Joel has buried humanity's cure to keep Ellie alive and lied to her face; Ellie has accepted the answer for now. They ride back to Jackson as father and daughter, with every Firefly Joel killed leaving families who don't yet know his name.

Hope and Landon both fell unconscious after Josie's rescue and neither can be woken. Rafael, reanimated and weaponised by the Necromancer, is loose in the woods, and the Necromancer now carries the dark magic that used to be Josie's.
Baltimore is a trap: Amy Granderson's troopers hold the Nathan James, its crew, and the world's only vaccine, while Patient Zero Niels Sorenson is loose ashore somewhere in disguise.

The Landon everyone welcomed home was actually Malivore wearing his face. Malivore has now revealed himself and taken Cleo — and when the Super Squad demand their friends back, he replies there is something he wants too.

Amon is dead, the Equalist uprising broken, and Korra is a fully realised Avatar for the first time — airbending mastered, bending restored, Aang's spirit having reached her directly. She has her power back, but she has never lived as the Avatar the world expects her to be.

The Briarwoods are dead but Ripley escaped and the ritual to the Whispered One left an ominous black orb beneath Whitestone. Just as Emon celebrates Vox Machina as heroes, four unknown dragons descend on the capital.

Umbrasyl is dead, but Thordak still rules occupied Emon and broods over a clutch of unhatched eggs, with Vorugal still at his side. The green dragon Raishan has revealed herself and is now offering Vox Machina an alliance — with motives entirely her own.

Ken is dead, Landon serves as the Ferryman of Limbo, and Alaric has left to write the definitive history of the supernatural. Hope has put her necklace back on and, alongside Caroline, welcomes a new class of witches, vampires and werewolves to the Salvatore School.

The Chroma Conclave is destroyed and Percy has been resurrected, at the cost of a deeper curse on Vax and a scattered Vox Machina. In a distant temple, cultists complete a ritual that summons the Whispered One as a full-fledged evil god.

The Whispered One has ascended to full godhood, exactly as he planned — Vox Machina's own killing blow was the final step of his ritual. He has forced them to kneel before him on a broadcast seen across Exandria, and disintegrated Vax for refusing.
David has just been freed from years of possession, but Farouk has escaped inside Oliver's body — and before David can catch his breath, a floating orb appears and carries him away.

Hope has sealed Malivore by throwing herself and Clarke into the pit. The world's memory of her is erased, and Landon has resurrected alone into a school and a father figure who don't know she ever existed.

Charles's truce with both Farouks spares his son but unwinds the future David and Syd had lived through; the timeline resets and the two of them fade away, hoping the new versions of themselves will find a better life.

David has been exposed as a monster who assaulted Syd and fled with Lenny into hiding; Farouk sits arrested at the peak of his restored power, and the team he abandoned is left to hunt the man they trained.
Gates is dead and Hunter is in police custody, but the mole known only as 'The Caddy' — Cottan — is still serving, and his boss now has plenty to trade.
The mole is dead and Fairbank is going down, but Cottan's dying declaration hints at a wider network of corrupt officers, and the OCG that recruited him has never been touched.
Hunter is dead, Denton is serving life, and Dryden is disgraced — but Cottan has walked deeper into AC-12 with a dead officer taking the blame for his own crimes.
Buckells is in custody as the Fourth Man, but the senior officers who let him climb have not been touched, and Osborne is quietly closing down the anti-corruption unit that caught him.
The Amrohi mission succeeded and destroyed Cruz. She has cut Joe off, Joe is questioning the Lioness program, and Neal is quietly certain his wife kills people for a living.

Pat Brown has landed on Malibu's beach with two armed men in hazmat suits. Carol is pregnant with what everyone believes is Tandy's baby, Erica with the late Phil's, and Mike has vanished into the desert possibly carrying the virus.

Pablo now runs Los Tigres for the CIA, Chinese scientists and an MSS agent are dead in Iran, and Joe — nearly killed on the border — has come home to Neal, who told her she'll always have a home to return to.

The Lockes think they've won. Dodge is actually living inside Kinsey's new boyfriend Gabe, Eden was also possessed at the Black Door, and Ellie — Rufus's mother — was sent through it in Dodge's disguised form.

Kinsey stabs Gideon with the Alpha Key and Nina shoves him into his own portal. The Lockes throw the keys through to seal it, first using the Memory Key so they'll never forget the magic. Yet whispering can still be heard at Keyhouse.
Hilton is dead and Huntley is in prison, but Cottan's dying words insisted there is a senior officer with an 'H' surname inside the force — and Hastings knows he's still on the list.

Dodge is dead, but Eden summoned an older, worse demon named Gideon at the well and got thrown down it for her trouble. Gideon is loose in Matheson with the Anywhere Key, and Tyler — grieving Jackie — has left on a road trip refusing to remember any of it.

Sylvie has killed the TVA's architect and torn the Sacred Timeline open into an uncontrolled multiverse. Loki is stranded in a TVA that has no memory of him, where a statue of one of He Who Remains' variants now stands in place of the fake Time-Keepers.

Loki now sits alone at the End of Time, personally holding the branching multiverse together as a living tree. Sylvie and Mobius have walked away into quiet lives, and the reformed TVA hunts He Who Remains' other variants across the branches.

Sauron now holds the nine Rings for Men, Eregion has fallen, and Celebrimbor is dead. The surviving Elves have retreated to a hidden valley, Númenor has slid into open hostility toward the Faithful, and Elendil has fled west with the sword Narsil.

Alfred is dead and Edward wears the crown Uhtred fought to secure. But Cnut still commands the Danish army in the north, Brida still believes a Saxon killed Ragnar, and Uhtred's family and lands are lost.
The Biggeloe cell is broken and Hastings has kept his job, but 'H' has not been proven singular, half the bribe money is unaccounted for, and an OCG child from years back is now a serving officer.

flags.claim: an OCG child from years back is now a serving officer
flags.evidence: Ryan Pilkington joins the police academy.
flags.correction: At the end of the season Pilkington has only just joined the police academy — he is a trainee, not yet a serving officer.

results.cliff: The hatch stands open with a light burning at the bottom. Walt is somewhere at sea in the hands of strangers, Sawyer is bleeding out on a pontoon, and Rousseau's warning about the Others has just come true.

Jack has called the freighter over Charlie's dying warning that it isn't Penny's. And in a flash the show has just admitted is the future, off the island, a bearded and broken Jack tells Kate they need to go back.

The three Elven Rings have been forged with Sauron's guidance and no one but Galadriel and Elrond knows it. Sauron has fled Eregion, the Southlands are now Mordor, and Númenor has vowed to return for vengeance.

Jacob is dead, stabbed by Ben on the orders of a man wearing John Locke's face — while Locke's actual corpse sits in a crate on the beach. In 1977, Juliet has just struck the Jughead's core, and the screen has gone white.

The island survived. Its protector died to save it. Everyone who mattered — the ones who lived, the ones who died on the sub, the ones who died decades apart — finally gathered in a place they built together to find each other again.
The Robinsons are back together on Jupiter 2, but the alien engine has hurled them to an unknown star system Will recognises as 'Danger'. Smith is caged; Robot is lost in space.

The island is gone. The Oceanic Six have been living a public lie for years; the rest of the survivors have been abandoned somewhere in time. Jack has finally cracked, standing over Locke's coffin as Ben tells him everyone left has to come back — and take the body with them.

The children's Jupiter has arrived not at Alpha Centauri but at an unknown system, staring at the derelict Fortuna — the ship of Judy's biological father, missing for twenty years. Robinsons, Don, Smith and Robot are scattered across the escape.
Alpha Centauri is safe, the war with the robots is over, and the Robinsons have settled into new lives. Will and the transformed Robot have set out together to explore beyond the colony.
Victor has thanked Simon and hung up, ready to run to whichever boy he has chosen — Benji, who is fragile and pulling away, or Rahim, who has just kissed him. The audience is not told which.
Lucifer has traded his return to Hell for Chloe's life, and God has held him to it by loosing his mother's soul on Earth. Neither brother knows what body she's wearing or what she'll do first.

Victor comes out to his parents on the same night they announce their separation, with no idea how either of them will respond. Benji is newly single and waiting, Mia is heartbroken, and the family is fractured.

The Swan has imploded in a violet burst that lit up the sky. Jack, Kate, Sawyer and Hurley are prisoners of the Others. Michael and Walt are motoring away to freedom, alone, having gotten there by murder.
Lucifer has returned to Hell voluntarily to keep demons from Earth, leaving Chloe with a mutual 'I love you' and no idea when — or whether — he'll come back. Eve has left to find herself.

The series ends here. Lucifer is the therapist of Hell, Amenadiel is God, Rory has taken her place in her own time, and Chloe has lived a full life on Earth before being reunited with Lucifer for good.

Lucifer has exiled his mother to her own universe and lost the Flaming Sword with her. He wakes in the desert with the wings he burned in Season 1 back on his shoulders, and no idea who put them there.

Don's Kodak triumph is undercut by a house standing empty for Thanksgiving. Adam has hanged himself, Peggy has secretly given birth to Pete's son, and Pete now knows Don was once someone called Dick Whitman.

Sterling Cooper has been sold to PPL, Duck's coup has failed, and Don has walked back into a marriage that now includes a baby conceived on the eve of separation. Peggy has finally told Pete he fathered her child.
Chloe is standing across from Lucifer, staring at his devil face, having just watched him kill her ex-fiancé. Everything he's ever said turns out to have been literal.

SCDP has clawed itself back from Lucky Strike's exit with a pantyhose account, and Don has stunned the office by announcing he is marrying his secretary Megan instead of the woman everyone expected. Faye is out, Bert has quit, and Joan is quietly carrying Roger's child as her husband ships out.
Lucifer has proved himself worthy of the vacant throne of Heaven and the assembled angels are kneeling before him. Dan is in Hell, Michael is wingless, and Chloe is alive again.

Smith is dead, the American invasion of the Pacific States is halted, and the Nebenwelt portal stands wide open with people from countless other realities pouring into this one. Abendsen has walked through it to another life.

Zeke has walked out of a cave with the same blood marker as the 828 passengers, proving the phenomenon isn't unique to the flight. In Michaela's apartment, a fight between Zeke and Jared triggers an off-camera gunshot, and the Death Date - June 2, 2024 - now hangs over everyone.

On the Death Date, Flight 828 rose from a fissure, the passengers boarded and were judged - eleven turned to ash - and the plane returned intact to April 7, 2013. Everyone lost along the way is alive again; the returnees are stepping back into the lives they were meant to have, with Cal restored to boyhood and no memory of the years he lived.
Kilgrave is dead but IGH is not. Trish has just found that the shadow company paid for Jessica's care after her family's fatal accident, and Simpson has been quietly retrieved by Dr Kozlov.
The season and series end with Victor and Benji reunited on the Ferris wheel where the show began, and every friend paired off or moving on to a new city.

Fisk is back in prison but bought his freedom for Vanessa's silence over Nadeem's murder, and the firm is reborn as Nelson, Murdock & Page. Dex, paralyzed by Fisk, is on a surgeon's table having his spine rebuilt.

Trish has killed Jessica's newly-found mother Alisa, and Jessica has taken the blame to protect her. Trish's own body is reacting to Malus' half-finished procedure — her reflexes are quickening — and the sisters are barely speaking.

Frank has been officially cleared and his family avenged, but he tells Curtis's support group that he's scared of who he is without a war. Russo lives — disfigured, publicly blamed for everything — and Madani has recovered from a bullet to the head knowing exactly who put it there.

Jessica has publicly unmasked her sister Trish as the killer 'Hellcat' and sent her to the Raft. She almost fled the country afterwards but stayed after hearing Kilgrave's voice in her head telling her to abandon everyone.

Midge has just torn down the fourth wall on The Gordon Ford Show and been fired for it seconds after Gordon offered her a couch spot on air. Fame has arrived; every relationship she leaned on to reach it — Susie, Joel, Lenny, Gordon, Hedy — is compromised.

Cate, May, Keiko, and Tim have rejoined Monarch and are hunting Kentaro. He and Isabel have escaped to Thailand chasing her promise to reach the 2014 version of Hiroshi trapped in Axis Mundi. Shaw is already there, and has just found Rodan waiting inside a volcano.

Alex is sick with COVID and openly refusing to apologize for who she is on national television. Bradley has walked off the show to find her missing brother, moments after Cory told her he is in love with her.

Alex has resigned from TMS but she and Cory have exposed Celine's Wolf River cover-up on live television, forcing Celine out of UBN. Bradley has been freed from a Belarus prison and the network is looking for its next interim CEO.

Stage 2 is armed, Elliot has just been shot by Tyrell to keep it that way, and Angela is now Whiterose's convert. In the desert, Trenton tells Mobley she has found a way to undo the hack before both are approached by Leon.
Whiterose is dead, her machine destroyed, and the persona the viewer has known as Elliot has stepped aside to return control to the real Elliot, who wakes in a hospital with Darlene beside him.

Five/Nine has landed and the world is in chaos. Elliot has no memory of the final days of the plan, Tyrell is gone, and Whiterose is already speaking with E Corp's CEO about who is really responsible.

Five/Nine is being reversed and Elliot has vowed to take down Whiterose. Angela, told Price is her real father, is being pulled off Whiterose's side. Outside Elliot's building, Vera has returned and is standing in front of Darlene.
The League has been repelled but not caught, All Might's power is nearly spent, and Shigaraki is being coached by an unseen master with plans far bigger than one school raid.

The Randas — Cate, Kentaro, Hiroshi, and long-lost Keiko — are reunited with May and Tim at an Apex Cybernetics station on Skull Island. Shaw is stranded in Axis Mundi again, and Kong is bearing down on the station.
Stain's captured, but his 'purge fake heroes' creed is spreading fast, the League is recruiting off it, and Shigaraki is being groomed to lead them just as Class 1-A break for summer camp.

Overhaul is beaten but the League walked off with his Quirk-destroying bullets, Mirio is Quirkless, Nighteye is dead, and Izuku has started hearing past holders of One For All in his sleep just as Hawks joins the top ranks.

Alex has just killed Paul's UBA takeover by threatening to expose that he faked the hack to hide a rocket failure. Bradley has resigned on-air and is walking into an FBI interview to turn her brother in for the Jan 6 assault she once covered up.

Félix stands atop a federation he holds together by murder, betrayal and political favours. The DEA has abandoned legal channels and launched Operation Leyenda specifically to bring down everyone who touched Kiki.

Pablo's stage-managed surrender at La Catedral has collapsed into a standoff: the government is moving to take the prison by force while Murphy, Peña and a newly-assertive Cali Cartel all wait for him to run.

All Might is finished as a fighter and All For One is imprisoned in Tartarus, but Shigaraki now inherits the League with his master's blessing, Endeavor has been thrust into the #1 slot he isn't ready for, and yakuza Overhaul is knocking on the League's door.

Devi and Paxton are finally, publicly together while a devastated Ben looks on. Kamala has walked out on her arranged engagement to sing karaoke with Manish, and Nalini has quietly stepped back from Chris.

Devi has just kissed Ben in his car after finally grieving her father with her mother, only to come home and find Paxton on her doorstep leaving her a message. Both boys are choosing her at the same moment.

Devi has decided to stay at Sherman Oaks for senior year and just walked into Ben's bedroom to have sex with him using the joke pass he gave her. Paxton has graduated toward Arizona State and Fabiola has begun dating Addison.
Latrelle's bullet has torn through both Ruby and Olivia at her own quinceañera and vanished into the night, while Jamal stands alone over a hole full of RollerWorld cash nobody else knows exists.

Shigaraki's Decay has evolved to city-wide range, his body is being rebuilt to weaponise it, and the League has just absorbed the 100,000-strong MLA into the Paranormal Liberation Front — with Hawks the only hero close enough to watch it happen.

Hannah and Garrett are together and honest with each other for the first time. Allie is quietly sleeping with Dean while sleeping with other men to keep it casual — and the new Hawks recruit Hunter, who she also slept with, has walked into their lives with a grudge against Dean.

Luffy, Zoro and Nami have a map to the Grand Line and a shaky partnership, but no ship worthy of the trip, no navigator's tools for its impossible weather, and a growing list of enemies who now know their faces.

The Straw Hats are sailing for Alabasta with its exiled princess aboard, knowing that the country's civil war is being manufactured by a Warlord of the Sea who has already put a target on their backs.
The trio has cleared its name and Oliver has staged the Broadway comeback of his life. On opening night, his leading man collapses onstage in front of a full house.
The crew is escorting Princess Vivi home to stop a Warlord-backed rebellion, with Baroque Works now hunting them by name. The log pose points at Little Garden, not Alabasta.
The Tim Kono case is closed, but the trio is walked out of the Arconia in handcuffs, framed for the murder of board president Bunny Folger by an unseen enemy.

flags.claim: framed for the murder of board president Bunny Folger by an unseen enemy
flags.evidence: Oliver and Charles receive a mysterious text message telling them to leave the building.
flags.correction: The source describes an anonymous text luring Charles and Oliver to the scene, but does not state they were framed by an 'unseen enemy' — however, the framing/setup by an unknown party is a reasonable reading. The claim of being 'framed' is supported implicitly.

results.cliff: The series ends resolved rather than open. Devi leaves for Princeton with Ben as her boyfriend at nearby Columbia, Fabiola heads to Howard, Eleanor stays in LA acting with Trent, Kamala takes the Baltimore job with Manish, Paxton returns to ASU to pursue teaching, and Nalini quietly dates Andres.
Peter is departing on his first mission as a full Night Agent, now in a relationship with Rose and finally holding proof his father died before he could turn.

Luffy has a swordsman and a reluctant navigator and a stolen map to the Grand Line, but no way in and no ship built for it. Nami is riding with them for her own reasons, not because she has joined the crew.

The inmates are frolicking briefly free in a lake outside the walls. Buses of new prisoners are pulling into Litchfield, and a stranger — Kubra's assassin — has just cornered Alex alone in the greenhouse.
The Arconia is saved and the mayor is in prison. Then the trio finds their long-time rival Cinda Canning dying at the building's front gates.

Klaus, Elijah, and Hayley have publicly lost Hope to protect her — she is alive and hidden with Rebekah. Meanwhile Esther has taken over the fourth Harvest girl Cassie, a boy at her side calling her mother, and Davina has secretly brought Mikael back from the ashes.

The series closes on scattered endings. Alex is transferred to an Ohio prison and Piper moves there to be near her. Taystee, serving life, launches the Poussey Washington Fund with Judy King's help. Blanca reunites with Diablo in Honduras. Tamika is fired; Hellman replaces her as warden.

CERT officers have blown the bunker door as ten inmates — Piper, Alex, Red, Taystee, Nicky, Suzanne, Cindy, Blanca, Gloria, and Frieda — link arms inside. Piscatella lies dead in the hallway. Everyone else has been loaded onto buses to unknown prisons overnight.

Klaus and Elijah are dead by their own hands, staked with white oak to destroy the Hollow forever. Hope survives, orphaned but free of the spirit's magic, and the remaining Mikaelsons — Rebekah, Kol, Freya — walk into lives without their brothers for the first time in a thousand years.

Sarah has rescued Kira and blinded Rachel, but Mrs. S has secretly traded Helena to the military and the existence of male Castor clones — and a young second-generation clone named Charlotte — has just been revealed.
Sarah has walked away from Dyad's offer and come home to a ransacked house — Kira and Mrs. S are missing, and Alison has already signed her life away to Leekie.

Neolution has been outed as the real power behind both clone projects. Delphine has been shot at point-blank range, and Rachel is captive on an unknown island with Charlotte and her supposedly dead mother Susan Duncan.

Rachel has betrayed Susan, hijacked the cure, and put herself in front of Neolution's founder P.T. Westmorland. Sarah is bleeding on the island while Ferdinand — now defected back to Neolution — holds Kira and Mrs. S hostage.
Rogelio and Xo have finally married. Rose is jailed at last, but Luisa is scheming revenge on Rafael — and Anezka has cornered Petra alone with a gun.

Mark has beaten Angstrom nearly to death and glimpsed a future in which he loves Eve, but he cannot yet say it out loud. Light-years away, his father sits in a Viltrumite prison finally admitting he was wrong, and a fellow inmate is quietly offering him a way out.
Zombies are public knowledge, Fillmore-Graves is mediating a fragile new peace, and Ravi has just been scratched by Liv to test whether his experimental vaccine actually holds.
Blaine's brain empire is a burning ruin and both he and Major are human again, but Peyton has fled after seeing Liv feed, and Max Rager knows exactly what Liv is.
Uhtred finally sits in Bebbanburg with Stiorra and his sons, ruling Northumbria as neither Saxon nor Scot — sworn to Edward, but not part of his England. Hild is leading a young Osbert to his door.

Official brain shipments to New Seattle are dead. Major now runs Fillmore-Graves and is secretly buying smuggled brains from Blaine to keep zombies fed, while Liv, publicly outed as Renegade, keeps her humans-through-the-wall operation running.

A brand new firm — Sterling Cooper Draper Pryce — has been born in a hotel suite, staffed by defectors and no clients guaranteed. Don has lost his marriage, and Betty is already on a plane to Reno with Henry Francis.

Lane is dead, Peggy is gone to CGC, Joan is a partner at a cost she and Don both know, and Megan is now a paid actress via a favour Don couldn't help himself from doing. Don walks away from her set alone, into a bar, into a familiar question.

SC&P is a real firm with a real Chevy account, but Don has been suspended from the agency he founded and separated from his wife after telling clients the truth about the brothel. Sally has caught him mid-affair; Pete is quietly holding blackmail on Bob Benson.
Quarles is dead, Arlo is in prison confessing to protect Boyd, and Winona has walked out on Raylan. Boyd controls Harlan through Shelby's badge and Ava's brothel.

Annalise walks out of court a free woman just as Frank and Bonnie are gunned down avenging her. A flashforward decades on shows Laurel and Wes's grown son Christopher inheriting Annalise's chair at Middleton after her funeral.

Hitler is dead and Himmler now rules the Reich, publicly praising Smith for uncovering Heusmann's plot. Thomas has volunteered himself into euthanasia, and Abendsen has told Juliana that Trudy is alive somewhere.
Boyd walks free with Raylan's silent blessing, stripped of his father, brother, and faith. Ava is a widow sleeping with Raylan; Arlo is a father who tried to have him killed.

flags.claim: Ava is a widow sleeping with Raylan
flags.evidence: Bo's men occupy Bowman's house on his orders and harass Ava, who witnesses Winona leave Raylan's motel room after having sex with him.
flags.correction: Ava is a widow, but it is Winona (Raylan's ex-wife) who is sleeping with him, not Ava; Ava tried to seduce Raylan earlier but he turned her down, and their only physical contact was a kiss in E3.

results.cliff: Grace lies stabbed by Angelina, who has taken Eden. Cal has vanished after touching the tailfin, then reappeared as an adult beside his dying mother, and Captain Bill Daly - long presumed lost - has flickered into view aboard a phantom Flight 828 in the Eureka lab.

The Nebenwelt portal is operational and Juliana has just crossed into a parallel world with Smith's bullet in her body. Frank is dead, Himmler lies wounded from a Resistance sniper, and Abendsen is Smith's prisoner.

Tagomi has crossed by meditation into an alternate 1962 where the Allies won and the Cuban Missile Crisis is unfolding. Juliana has escaped Joe knowing he is SS, and a frail Hitler still rules a Reich Heydrich almost seized.

Saanvi has killed Kathryn Fitz by accident and is hiding it from Vance and everyone else. A Cuban fishing boat has just hauled Flight 828's tailfin from the ocean, meaning the plane the passengers landed in was already wreckage.

Elektra is dead saving Matt but the Hand have stolen her body for their resurrection device. Nelson & Murdock is dissolved, Karen finally knows Matt is Daredevil, and Frank Castle has embraced the Punisher mantle.
Fisk is in federal custody and his crime alliance shattered, leaving Hell's Kitchen without a kingpin. Matt now openly fights as Daredevil while Karen carries the secret that she killed Wesley.

Midge has claimed the stage as 'Mrs. Maisel' at the Gaslight, a triumph Joel witnessed from the shadows. Her career has begun; her marriage, her family life, and her livelihood are all still unresolved.

Mad Men ends. SC&P has been absorbed into McCann. Betty is dying and Sally is going home to look after Bobby and Gene. Peggy is with Stan, Joan is running her own production company, Pete has left for Wichita with Trudy, and Don — stripped of car, wife and firm — sits on a Californian hillside, smiles, and the Coke ad plays.

flags.claim: Sally is going home to look after Bobby and Gene
flags.evidence: Sally cancels a trip to Madrid to care for her siblings.
flags.correction: The source for this season refers to Sally's 'siblings' and names Bobby, but never names Gene.

results.cliff: Ford is face-down in a Californian hospital corridor mid-panic-attack, the OPR is holding the Speck tape, and in Kansas an ADT serviceman is burning his sadistic drawings of women.

Margo holds Bodhi and a growing OnlyFans empire, but her family has been remade by the fight to keep him. Shyanne's marriage is fractured by Kenny's CPS call, Jinx is clean but exiled, and Mark now has a legal foothold in Bodhi's life every other weekend.

Three months on, Frank is operating openly as the Punisher and has turned down every path back to a normal life. Russo is dead, the Schultzes are ruined, Amy is starting over in Florida with their money, and Madani has been promoted to a CIA that would very much like to point Frank somewhere useful.

flags.claim: the Schultzes are ruined
flags.evidence: Castle kills Eliza when she attacks Amy, and they blackmail Anderson, who kills himself after they leave.
flags.correction: Both Schultzes are dead by the end of the season — Eliza killed by Castle, Anderson by suicide after being blackmailed — not merely ruined.

results.cliff: Midge and Susie are stranded on the tarmac after being fired for Midge nearly outing Shy at the Apollo. She has no tour, no headline slot, and no plan; Susie has a growing gambling problem she hasn't told her about.

Midge has set her sights on The Gordon Ford Show as her route to fame, chastened by Lenny's warning to stop fearing failure. Mei is pregnant with Joel's baby and Moishe is recovering from a heart attack.
Midge is about to leave for a six-month tour opening for Shy Baldwin, her family finally knows what she does, and she has just spent the night with the husband she was ready to leave.
Williams is charged for two killings while the other Atlanta families get no answers, Tench comes home to an empty house, and BTK is still free in Wichita surrounded by his trophies.

Félix sits in a Mexican prison, handed to the Americans as a NAFTA offering. From behind bars he warns Walt that the newly independent Tijuana, Sinaloa and Juárez cartels are about to tear the country apart.

All Might is standing bloody but defiant against an All For One who keeps rewinding younger, Bakugo lies dead-in-appearance with Edgeshot inside him trying to repair his heart, Deku is locked in a grinding fight against a Shigaraki whose true self has retaken the body while All For One's rewinding form races to reunite with him, and Toga is gone.

All For One is erased and Shigaraki died at peace with Izuku, but hero society is rebuilding around the crater they left, Spinner is writing a book so Shigaraki won't be forgotten, and Izuku is stepping back into the fight as a Quirkless hero in an armored suit.

Amado has apparently died in surgery and been buried, but a final shot in Chile shows him alive with his lover, two wine glasses waiting. The Tijuana–Sinaloa war has burned itself down to Enedina holding a shattered AFO and Mayo executing Ramón in the street.

The Stevensons are wiped out and Conrad and Maeve are behind bars, but Kevin is stepping into a throne he isn't ready for while Harry lies bleeding on his own kitchen floor, stabbed by his wife. Kat McAllister is circling with a power-sharing offer, and Conrad — cheered by his fellow inmates — is very much not finished.
Peter is free but planted as a double agent against Jacob Monroe, who now effectively owns the incoming US President. He and Rose have agreed they cannot risk being together.

The Hagans have escaped legal consequence via self-pardon, the Father has walked away with his son but is still killing to tidy loose ends, and Peter is preparing to head back into the field with a new partner assigned by Mosley.
The Ben Glenroy case is closed and Oliver's musical is a hit. Then Charles's best friend Sazz is killed by a sniper's bullet fired into his apartment - meant, it seems, for him.

Joanne has said she can't convert and Noah has chosen her anyway, kissing her outside the bat mitzvah. Nothing about the head-rabbi job, his family, or their fundamentally incompatible lives has actually been settled — they've just decided to keep going.
Sazz is avenged and Oliver is finally married. The next morning the trio finds Lester, the Arconia's doorman of thirty years, drowned in the courtyard fountain.
Rosa has just killed Vee with the stolen prison van and vanished. Red is recovering in medical, Suzanne has been exonerated, and both major smuggling networks that ran Litchfield have collapsed.

Daya is standing over CO Humphrey with his own drawn gun as inmates around her scream for her to shoot. Poussey lies dead in the cafeteria, Caputo has publicly refused MCC's order to fire Bayley, and the prison is one squeeze from full revolt.

The League escaped with an All For One who now inhabits both his original body and Shigaraki's, every Tartarus convict is loose, Dabi has publicly outed himself as Endeavor's son, and Class 1-A has three days to prepare for the final war — with an American hero flying in alone to help.

flags.claim: every Tartarus convict is loose
flags.evidence: Deku brings Muscular to prison... Endeavor apprehends Overhaul... Hawks arrives just in time to rescue her [Lady Nagant].
flags.correction: Several Tartarus escapees have already been re-captured or killed by season's end — Muscular is back in prison, Overhaul is apprehended, and Lady Nagant is critically injured/rescued after All For One's failsafe detonates.

results.cliff: Marcel now rules New Orleans as an unkillable enhanced Original, with Klaus daggered and walled inside their old home. The rest of the Mikaelsons lie hexed or super-bitten in coffins, kept alive only by Freya's spell, while Hayley and toddler Hope drive them across the country hunting cures that may not exist.
Piper is beating Pennsatucky unconscious in the snowy prison yard while Healy deliberately walks away. Larry has left her, Alex has cut her out, and the outcome of the fight is unknown.
Piper is out and struggling to adjust; Alex is stuck inside for years. Taystee has been convicted for a murder she didn't commit. Blanca, promised release, was seized at the gate by ICE.

flags.claim: Alex is stuck inside for years
flags.evidence: Alex asks Badison to leave Piper alone. Instead, Badison hires Hellman to frame Piper. To keep Badison in line, Alex agrees to work for Carol.
flags.correction: The source confirms Alex remains in prison at season's end (Piper is released while Alex stays), but does not specify a sentence length of 'years.' This is compression, not contradiction — no flag warranted on length itself. However, the source does not contradict Alex remaining inside.

results.cliff: Series finale — no cliffhanger. Westmorland is dead, Neolution is publicly exposed, Helena's twins are safely born, and the sisters are together at last, with a list of every Leda clone left to find and save.
The Pogues are stranded on a deserted island with no way home, the Camerons keep the gold, and unknown to John B, his father Big John is alive — striking a deal with Limbrey.

Dahlia is dead, Esther is dead, and Hope is home. But Rebekah walks around in a witch's body, Hayley is chained to a cursed pack she can only leave on a full moon, and the Mikaelsons have destroyed the oldest enemies they had left.
John B and Sarah are alive on a Bahamas-bound cargo ship — but the Pogues, Ward, and the police all think they drowned. Ward's stolen gold now sits in Nassau, waiting.

flags.claim: the Pogues, Ward, and the police all think they drowned
flags.evidence: John B reveals Ward's actions to the cops, leading to Ward's arrest, but the Phantom capsizes in the storm, and John B and Sarah are presumed dead.
flags.correction: Ward is under arrest at season's end, not free; and Ward personally witnessed/manipulated John B during the capsizing, so grouping him with the mourners is misleading — but the core issue is Ward is arrested, not simply believing them dead.

results.cliff: The Pogues are celebrated El Dorado heroes eighteen months on, having lost both Big John and Ward. Now they take on a new hunt — Blackbeard's lost ship — with strangers pointing the way.

flags.claim: with strangers pointing the way
flags.evidence: The group accepts another mission, that of Blackbeard's ship.
flags.correction: The source does not describe who brings them the Blackbeard mission; it only says the group accepts it.

results.cliff: Twenty years on, Claire knows Jamie lived through Culloden but not where or when to find him now; Brianna has just learned Frank is not her father, and Geillis Duncan has already vanished into the stones ahead of them.
A shattered Jamie and a pregnant Claire sail for France, hoping to derail Prince Charles Stuart's rebellion before it can lead to Culloden.
JJ is dead — murdered by his own biological father Chandler Groff moments after declaring his love for Kiara. Groff has vanished toward Lisbon with the Blue Crown. Sarah is carrying John B's child.
Claire and Jamie are alive but stranded on a beach in British America, with no ship, no plan, and enemies both English and colonial still hunting Jamie.
Jamie has been ordered by the man who granted him his land to hunt down and kill his own godfather, while Young Ian remains a captive of the Mohawk.
Lord John has just been knocked out and taken by Captain Richardson; Jamie is preparing for the battle Frank's book says will kill him; and the hint that Faith survived Paris hangs unresolved.

Jamie is believed drowned on the Euterpe; Claire faces the gallows for espionage and Lord John has just proposed marriage to save her; and Buck is stranded in 1739 in Geillis Duncan's care as Dougal MacKenzie approaches with clues to Roger's own father.

Jamie is now a Continental Brigadier General under Washington and has escaped British arrest by taking Lord John hostage; William knows the truth of his birth and is furious; Kings Mountain is still coming.

Team 7 is stranded deep in the Forest of Death mid-exam. Sasuke carries an unknown cursed mark placed by a legendary rogue ninja who has openly claimed him, Naruto's chakra is sealed, and the Sound trio pressing them has just been met head-on by Ino, Shikamaru and Chōji.

Claire is recovering from a battle wound; Roger has finally reunited with Brianna and the children in 1739; Rachel is pregnant with Ian's child; and Fanny's song has left Claire believing her Paris daughter Faith may be alive.

The portal home is destroyed and Belos is rebuilding it while his Golden Guard watches the Owl House. Eda's curse has been forced onto Lilith too, so both sisters can barely do magic and Luz is stuck on the Isles with only her glyphs.

The Day of Unity was stopped only by handing the Boiling Isles to the Collector, a childlike being who now treats its people as toys. Luz, Amity, Willow, Gus and Hunter are stranded in the human realm, and a surviving fragment of Belos has crossed over with them without their knowing.
Del is dead by Darlene's hand at the casino summit, the Snell heroin deal is uneasily alive, and the Byrdes have publicly chosen to stay in the fallout instead of running.

The show ends here. Belos is gone for good, the Collector has been befriended rather than killed, and drawn glyph magic has died with the Titan. Four years on, Luz has grown up in the human world and come back to the Boiling Isles for college, greeted by everyone she loves.
The casino is open under cartel management and the family has chosen to stay, but Wendy has crossed a line without Marty's knowledge and Helen represents a cartel with no more patience for failure.
Helen is dead at the Byrdes' feet and Navarro tells them this promotion is the start of far closer cooperation, while Ruth has cut ties with Marty knowing Wendy killed the man she loved.

The Byrdes are home and apparently untouchable — Camila runs the cartel with the FBI's blessing — but private investigator Mel is at their door with Ben's ashes as proof they had him killed, and Jonah has just raised a shotgun as a shot rings out.

The murder is solved but the bigger lie — that the world outside is livable and that survivors were abandoned — is now half-exposed. Collins has flown out to find Teri; Redmond is wounded but alive, and Driscoll walks free.

Paradise is evacuated and Redmond is dead, but the militia now occupies the ruined bunker and Collins has been sent by a time-manipulating AI to reach a second facility beneath Denver Airport. Link has just learned he is Redmond's son and met his newborn daughter, while Driscoll's body has vanished from Torabi's shower.

flags.claim: Driscoll's body has vanished from Torabi's shower
flags.evidence: During the evacuation, there is a brief scene showing that Jane is no longer laying in Dr. Torabi's shower.
flags.correction: It is Jane whose body has vanished from Torabi's shower, not Driscoll's. Driscoll was killed by Torabi earlier in the episode, but the body that disappears from the shower is Jane's.

results.cliff: Adam is out of a job with a fourth mouth on the way, Crosby has blown up his engagement to Jasmine, and Amber has just survived a crash caused by her own spiral — while Max, for the first time, knows what's wrong with him.

Crosby and Jasmine are married, Adam and Crosby own a functioning studio, and Sarah has a fresh proposal from Mark — while Julia and Joel have just invited a preteen boy neither of them knows into their living room.

The Braverman family has absorbed Sarah's chaos and forgiven Zeek's affair, Crosby has decided to follow his newly discovered son to New York, and Max still doesn't know why school is so hard for him.

Kristina has beaten cancer, Victor is legally Julia and Joel's son, and Sarah has chosen Hank — who has just moved states to be near his daughter. Amber and Ryan are back together, but he is still fighting a war in his head.

Ryan is broken in a hospital bed halfway across the country, Amber is holding a pregnancy test, Julia and Joel are separated and both have strayed, and the family home has been sold — the center of everything has come apart.

The invasion is over and Chris's name is clear, but he goes home alone with only Eagly and the last living Butterfly in a jar — having just killed his father, still hallucinating him standing in the room.
Leslie's park is approved but unbuilt, the pit is still a pit, and the man who just fell into it is the same man she nearly kissed. Ann and Andy's relationship is quietly falling apart.

One week into finally dating Harcourt and launching Checkmate with his chosen family, Chris is snatched by Rick Flag Sr. and dumped into Salvation — a dimension A.R.G.U.S. built specifically to hold people like him.
Tommy is alive because a Crown assassin turned at the last second, and the message is that Churchill now owns him. Grace carries his child, and the family limps toward a wedding.
A gunshot rings out on the Birmingham station platform as Campbell levels his pistol at Grace. Tommy sits at his farmhouse, coin in hand, weighing whether to follow her to London.

Polly, Michael, Arthur and John sit in police custody, staring down murder charges Tommy engineered without telling them why. Charles is safe. Grace is buried. Whatever the deal is, only Tommy knows it.

Zeek is gone, but the family he built is intact and moving on — Julia and Joel back together, Amber holding a son named for her grandfather, Sarah married, Chambers Academy growing, and Camille preparing to travel the world Zeek never got to see.

Tommy's plan to assassinate Mosley failed because someone he trusted gave it away. He stands on a fog-choked field, gun in his mouth, hallucinating Grace, while Mosley walks free, Michael and Gina circle the throne, and Polly has quit the company.
Friendship patched at the dance — but the boys have detonated. Sam is her secret AIM crush, Brandt's cruelty was a crush too, and Anna's home is splitting in half.

Tommy has killed Michael, discovered his own death sentence was a fraud engineered by Mosley and Diana, and vanished on horseback. Mosley and the Nazis are ascendant, Arthur is hollowed out but alive, and the Shelby name is scattered between London, Boston and a burnt caravan on a hill.
The older-boyfriend experiment collapsed in a single night at Derrick's. Sam has become the boy Maya kissed for real, and Shuji has become the boy Anna cannot stop watching.
Tulip is dead in Jesse's arms. The Grail has taken over his life, the Saint is loose again, and Jesse has agreed to become their new Messiah.

Manousos has proven the Others can be killed en masse by a specific radio frequency, and Carol has had the hive deliver her an atom bomb and told him she's in. Meanwhile the Others are roughly a month from finishing her custom conversion virus from her stolen stem cells.
The story is over. God is dead on His own throne, Apocalypse was averted at the last second, Jesse and Tulip lived long enough to raise a daughter, and Cassidy finally chose the sunlight.

Jesse and Tulip are free of Angelville with Jesse's powers restored, but Cassidy has been captured by the Grail and is being tortured at Masada. Meanwhile God is loose on Earth working an unknown plan, and Hitler is now the devil.

Eight escapees are loose in Illinois. Sara has collapsed on morphine alone in her apartment, Reynolds sits in the Oval Office, and Aldo Burrows is out there hunted by the Company that once employed him.
Michael and Mahone are locked inside a lawless Panamanian prison the Company wanted them in. Sara is missing, and the General is watching everything unfold to plan.

Tommy has just been elected to Parliament, but he bought the seat with his lover's political contacts and hollowed out the family that survived the vendetta. Alfie lies on a beach, presumed dead; John is buried; Michael is boarding a ship for America.

Michael is home with Sara and their son, his real name restored. Jacob and T-Bag share a cell at Fox River, and the man who took years from the Scofields is locked in with the man who has every reason to end him.
Kliner's counterfeiting empire is ash, Joe's medal is buried in the dirt where he fell, and Reacher walks out of Margrave with nothing but his toothbrush and a debt he considers paid.

Annville is a smoking crater and Jesse, Tulip and Cassidy have taken off in search of a missing God. On the same road behind them, Heaven has just unleashed an immortal Old West gunslinger to bring Genesis back by any means.

Quinn is finally, actually dead; Teresa is home with her grandmother, Duffy has resigned from the DEA, and Richard has taken his father's leftover money and vanished. Reacher rides off on Beck's motorcycle, alone again.

The Company is broken and the crew are free with real immunity. Four years on, they stand at Michael's grave; Sara is raising his son alone, T-Bag is back inside a US prison, and the General waits for the needle.

The Hollow is contained only by geography — its magic is split across Klaus, Elijah, Rebekah, and Kol, and if any two Mikaelsons ever stand near each other the spirit will reassemble. Elijah has been stripped of his memory of the family entirely, and Hope is being raised as a Salvatore School student, separated from her father.

flags.claim: if any two Mikaelsons ever stand near each other the spirit will reassemble
flags.evidence: Vincent warns Hayley that once the ritual is complete, she will have to keep Hope far away from the Mikaelsons, to avoid the pieces of the Hollow recombining.
flags.correction: The rule per the source is that Hope must be kept away from the Mikaelsons to prevent recombination — not that any two Mikaelsons together triggers it. The season ends with Klaus visiting Elijah in France without incident.

results.cliff: Archie has been arrested for a murder Hiram engineered, moments after being sworn in as student body president. Hiram is consolidating criminal control of the whole Southside with Penelope, Penny Peabody, Malachi, and Sheriff Minetta.
Percival Pickens is Rivervale's new mayor after dissolving the council. The gang broke his book curse but he still runs the town, and Reggie has crossed to his side.

A flash-forward shows Archie, Betty, and Veronica in the woods, covered in blood, burning Jughead's beanie and vowing to split up so they never get caught. Penelope has escaped after killing Hal, and Charles Cooper has just introduced himself as Alice's FBI handler and Betty's half-brother.

The unit's killers are dead, Little Wing is buried by Homeland Security, and every surviving investigator walks away with roughly eight million dollars they never asked for. Reacher goes back on the road alone.

A videotape shows the gang in Riverdale masks stabbing Principal Honey to death, though they never touched him. The videotape auteur is still unknown, and Betty and Archie's stopped-at-the-line kiss hasn't gone away.
Hiram's bomb has just detonated under Archie's bed with Betty and Archie inside. Hiram drives out of Riverdale as the Andrews house lights up behind him.
The series closes with Betty stepping into the Sweet Hereafter Pop's, where her lost friends wait for her, forever teenagers. Their real lives are over; the story is complete.

The Waves are champions and Marcus has retired. Cam and Al have bought a rival LA team and poached Jay as its head coach, turning Isla's ex-rival, ex-lover and ousted brother into a single opposing front office.
The Waves fell one game short of the finals. Cam is back in the office intending to retake the presidency, and Isla has just kissed a rival team's coach.

flags.claim: Isla has just kissed a rival team's coach
flags.evidence: While reflecting on the game and the season, Isla and Jay share a kiss, but are unsure what to make of it.
flags.correction: Jay is the Waves' own coach, not a rival team's coach.

results.cliff: Dream has his tools and his purpose back, but Lucifer means to destroy him for the humiliation in Hell, Desire's family-blood scheme has been exposed and left unpunished, and Lyta Hall's dream-born son now belongs to the Dreaming.

Dream is gone; the child Daniel now sits on the throne, tasked with the same eternal role but carrying a mortal memory of mercy. The Endless are one short, the Kindly Ones warn that fate binds even them, and Destruction remains outside his family's reach.
The gang is stranded in a 1955 alt-reality Riverdale with entirely different lives. Only Jughead remembers who they really are, and nobody believes him.

Haniwa is a Trivantian prisoner of Baba's own brother. Maghra sits on a throne beside the sister who tried to kill her children, dispatching the Witchfinder army to find her family, while Baba and Kofun approach Edo's capital blind.

Maghra rules Paya but her sister is caged under her own roof, pregnant with Kofun's child and untouchable because of it. Baba has walked out into the mountains, and a Trivantian named Oloman has just shown his masters a weapon that no army in this world has ever faced.

Pennsa stands again on new terms. Maghra rules a kingdom that has just been rewritten by a weapon, Kofun is raising a blind son fathered on his aunt, and Haniwa has ridden out with Wren to find people like herself.
The living Jericho vanishes with Leanne into a cult everyone thought was dead. Dorothy has just accepted that her son is a doll, but not that he is gone.
Dorothy lies broken at the foot of the stairs, looking up at Leanne cradling Jericho. Leanne is no longer hiding what she can do; she runs the house, and the family knows it.

Leanne has bought her way into the family with a living child and a body hidden in the basement. She is no longer a captive — she is the Turners' protector, and alone in her room she has vowed war on the Church.
The Turners walk out of the burnt house without Leanne and without a child. Reyes tells Julian the Church saved his life last Christmas for a reason it hasn't named.
Dylan is tackled mid-contingency. Mark, Helly and Irving are yanked back inside Lumon before they can act on what they've just learned about their outies' lives.

Carrie has walked away from Big after he refused to acknowledge her as more than 'a friend' to his mother. The four women's experiment in loveless sex has, for Carrie at least, quietly collapsed into wanting the thing she said she didn't.

Otis has left Maeve a voicemail confessing everything, but Isaac deleted it before she heard it. Maeve believes Otis said nothing on the same night social services took her mother and toddler sister away.

Maeve has flown back to America to write and she and Otis have agreed to suspend contact entirely. Everyone has scattered from Cavendish's ordered world into decisions — coming out, leaving the church, kissing Isaac — that are still fresh.

The Princess Alliance has repelled the Horde and rediscovered the legend of She-Ra, but Catra has taken Shadow Weaver's place at Hordak's side and Entrapta is now secretly building weapons for the enemy.

flags.claim: Entrapta is now secretly building weapons for the enemy
flags.evidence: Catra wins Entrapta over to the Horde by claiming the others abandoned her and allowing her to use the Horde's resources for her research.
flags.correction: Entrapta has joined the Horde openly (from the Horde's perspective); the secrecy is that the Rebellion believes her dead, not that her weapons work is hidden from the Horde.

results.cliff: Michael has L.J. and Sofia back but not Sara, and he thinks she is dead. Whistler is loose with the Company, Gretchen has slipped away, and Sucre and Bellick are rotting in a Sona now ruled by T-Bag.
Shadow Weaver has fled to the enemy she once schemed against. Hordak's portal is nearly ready with Entrapta at his side, and Mara's message is pulling Adora toward the Crimson Waste.
Gemma is finally outside, but Mark has abandoned her to run with Helly. Cold Harbor is broken, Drummond is dead, and Lumon's alarms are ringing over Jame Eagan, Milchick and a defiant MDR.
Maeve has flown to America the same day she and Otis finally chose each other, Moordale is being sold out from under everyone, and Jean has just read a paternity result too shocking to share.
Sherlock and Moriarty face each other at a poolside, John wired with explosives between them, Sherlock's gun trained on the bomb. Nobody has moved.
Light Hope has named Scorpia the last princess needed to fire the Heart of Etheria — the weapon Mara died to stop, that Glimmer now wants to use.
John and the world believe Sherlock is dead; his reputation is destroyed and Moriarty is dead on the same roof. Only a few people know Sherlock is somehow still alive.
Adora carries a failsafe that will destroy the Heart of Etheria — and possibly her along with it. Catra, unable to bear it, has left. Horde Prime himself is descending to stop them.

Sherlock has murdered Magnussen and is being pulled back from exile because Moriarty's face is broadcasting nationwide asking whether he was missed. Mary's assassin past is out, and she and John are expecting a child.
The Bulldogs have finished the regular season undefeated and secured Sudbury as host of the National Senior Tournament. Shoresy is finally in something with Laura.
The Bulldogs are National champions but Shoresy has to retire after two concussions. A BroDude analyst gig and Nat's coaching offer both sit on the table, and Laura is finally in reach.

Shoresy has accepted the Bulldogs' coaching job, Laura has finally let him in, and the veteran roster is invested in the next generation. The season ahead starts with him behind the bench for the first time.

Toranaga's staged defeat has worked. Mariko's martyrdom has broken Ochiba's alliance with Ishido, the council has voted for open war, and Toranaga is finally free to move on Osaka and claim the shōgunate — with Blackthorne stranded in Japan, his ship secretly burned on Toranaga's orders.
Mary is dead, Eurus is subdued and back in confinement, and Sherlock and John are back at a rebuilt Baker Street with Mary's daughter and a message from Mary telling them to stay together.

Grace has just pushed her abusive husband Donny off a cliff, acting on Jimmy's advice never to accept his abuse again. On the same day, Gaby has quietly realised her feelings for Jimmy — the man she has twice fallen into bed with — are real.

The rebuilt Blueberry Bulldogs have gone from doormats to a packed-house team, and Nat has waived her fold-them-if-they-lose ultimatum. They head into the NOSHO playoffs against the Soo still owing Shoresy's promise to never lose.

Louis, the drunk driver who killed Tia, has been forgiven by Alice and by Jimmy — but Jimmy has ordered him to stay away from the family. Alone and suicidal on Thanksgiving night, Louis has reached Jimmy at the train station.

flags.claim: Louis has reached Jimmy at the train station
flags.evidence: he goes to the train station feeling suicidal and he reaches out to Alice, but Gaby has placed all her guests' phones in exile for the evening. Jimmy, however, discovers the message and meets with Louis at the train station.
flags.correction: Louis reached out to Alice, not Jimmy; Jimmy discovered the message on Alice's exiled phone and went to meet Louis at the train station.

results.cliff: The compression platform is dead and Pied Piper is now owned by Erlich and Big Head after a chain of accidents; Dinesh's throwaway video chat is the company's only real hope.
Pied Piper has won Battlefield and Richard is now running a real company he has no idea how to run, with a publicly humiliated Hooli plotting its next move.
Pied Piper survived the lawsuit but Raviga has taken control and fired Richard as CEO; Belson has been called before Hooli's board to answer for the Nucleus disaster.
Pied Piper's decentralized internet unexpectedly works on a network of smart refrigerators; Bream-Hall is funding it, Belson has retaken Hooli, and Erlich is stranded in Tibet.

The NOSHO is dead but the Northstars beat the touring Europeans on an outdoor rink in Sudbury, and Shoresy is now coach, cohabitant with Laura, and something close to family with her son Ben. The league he built the team in no longer exists.

To keep an AI that decrypts everything from ending global privacy, the team deliberately sabotaged their own AT&T launch; Pied Piper is dead as the biggest failure in tech and the founders have scattered.

Juliette and Bernard are trapped together in the firing incinerator while Sims and his family enter the Legacy vault, the rebellion holds the lower levels, and the Safeguard that can gas the entire Silo is armed and known.
Ryn's child is growing inside the surrogate Meredith, Ben is now a killer keeping that secret from Maddie, and Ted Pownall is haunted by memories he cannot yet let himself believe.
Ryn has fled back to the sea to spare Ben from her song's damage, but the song is still lodged in his head and the town now knows something at sea is killing its own.
Angella is dead. Entrapta is stranded on Beast Island and Catra has told no one. The opening portal broadcast Etheria's coordinates to Horde Prime, whose armada is now on its way.

flags.claim: Entrapta is stranded on Beast Island and Catra has told no one
flags.evidence: Catra, obsessed with vengeance, knocks her out and exiles her to Beast Island, threatening Scorpia with the same fate when she protests.
flags.correction: Scorpia witnessed the exile and protested it, so she knows Entrapta was sent to Beast Island — Catra has kept it from Hordak, not from everyone.

results.cliff: PiperNet is live, PiedPiperCoin is climbing, and the team has taken over four floors of Hooli's old offices; Yao and Jian-Yang are still running the rival network from China.

Henry, Ichabod and Katrina's son, has revealed himself as the Horseman of War, freed the Headless Horseman, handed Katrina to him, buried Ichabod alive, and trapped Abbie in purgatory. Moloch's second seal is broken and the Apocalypse has begun.

Abbie is dead. Ichabod, told her soul will be reborn in another Witness, is leaving Sleepy Hollow for Washington with a secret order founded by Washington himself. Jenny's long-absent father has just reappeared with information about the order.

Dreyfuss is dead, Agency 355 is reinstated, and Ichabod is finally an American citizen with a new partner and a new Witness. But he has sold his soul to Lucifer for the Philosopher's Stone, and the debt has not yet come due.
Ryn is alpha of all merpeople and raising Hope on the coast, but Ben is alive underwater as a merman and swimming somewhere no one knows. Maddie believes him dead and is leaving with Robb.

Slough House survives via mutual blackmail with Taverner rather than any real victory. Sid's records have been quietly erased, hinting she may still be alive somewhere, and Standish has just learned that Lamb gave her old friend Charles Partner the gun he used to kill himself.

The Popov conspiracy is officially buried as a routine security glitch, with Peter Judd emerging politically stronger from the cover-up. Katinsky is dead but Alex Tropper is allowed to return to her sleeper life, and the team quietly memorialises Min at St Leonard's without official recognition.

MI5's top two political operators, Tearney and Judd, have both been forced out by the Footprint leak. Standish has resigned in shock at her hero Partner's final betrayal, and River is quietly beginning to notice his grandfather David slipping into dementia.

Harkness walks free, protected by damning letters that would expose MI5's long-standing use of his mercenaries. Marcus is dead, David is committed against his will, and JK Coe has revealed a cold ruthlessness by executing Patrice at the end of the shootout.

Juliette is alive outside a neighbouring silo with a real view of a poisoned world and dozens of other silos on the horizon. Bernard rules Silo 18 uncontested, holds the hard drive, and believes she is dead.
The Family has a cook house running and Franklin is buying cocaine from Teddy, both sides unaware that the other is CIA and gang, respectively.

flags.claim: both sides unaware that the other is CIA and gang, respectively
flags.evidence: Rob follows Teddy after he sells cocaine to Avi.
flags.correction: Franklin buys cocaine from Avi, not directly from Teddy; the text conflates Teddy's CIA supply chain with Franklin's supplier. Franklin is not shown buying from Teddy at all this season.

results.cliff: Franklin has dropped the pretence of weakness and rules the streets, but Louie and Jerome are now his customers and rivals, and Cissy is grieving an Alton she doesn't know was murdered by Teddy.

Diana Taverner is finally First Desk and Peter Judd has emerged roughly £100m richer without any fingerprints on the payout. Slough House is saved but River is denied any promotion, and Lamb's scarred foot confirms the Stasi torture story he told his agents was his own.

The series ends with Cissy serving life for Teddy's murder and Franklin, years later, broke and alcoholic in her condemned house, walking away from Leon's offer of a way out and declaring himself "free from all of it."
Big Alice has clamped onto Snowpiercer and stopped it dead. Its envoy speaks for Mr. Wilford himself — and she is Melanie's long-lost daughter.

Franklin is out of jail and knows his supplier is a US intelligence officer — a secret he hasn't disclosed to anyone. Lucia and Gustavo have been released from custody but the DEA hasn't given up the chase.
Wilford now controls both Snowpiercer and Big Alice. Layton, Alex and a handful of allies are alone on a ten-car pirate train, chasing Melanie's data toward the last warm spot on Earth.
The launch is stopped and Snowpiercer is grounded to help power New Eden. Far beyond the warm spot, flowers have begun to grow on their own — the Earth may be healing without them.
Franklin is broke, at open war with his own uncle and aunt, and has just aligned with his mother and a KGB agent to kill Teddy — the only man who knows where his money went.
A great tragedy leaves the club reeling. Jax buries his father's ghost, walking into a fight with Clay that neither has yet named.
Abel is gone, Half-Sack is dead, Tara is bound in her own home, and Gemma is a fugitive wanted for a murder she did not commit. Cameron is somewhere in the wind with Jax's son.

Big Alice's passengers reach the Horn of Africa and find it warm and habitable — New Eden is real. Months later, Melanie, still driving Snowpiercer around the world, spots a rocket exploding on the horizon.
Clay is in prison framed for Pope's murder, Tara is under arrest facing federal charges, and Bobby has walked away from the table. Jax has consolidated power by lying to everyone who trusts him.
Abel is home and Jax's secret deal with Stahl has come to a head — and Tara has discovered more about the Teller family history than she could have ever imagined.

Tony has survived a hit ordered by his own mother, but she has slipped consequences behind a convenient stroke and Junior sits in a jail cell refusing to flip. Pussy is still missing, and Melfi is in hiding.
Franklin lies bleeding on Melody's floor. The Bloods–Crips gang war has erupted; his own murder of Andre and his knowledge of Teddy's CIA identity are both still buried.

flags.claim: Franklin lies bleeding on Melody's floor
flags.evidence: he wakes up in the real world, having survived being shot with Alton tending to him for the past few months... Now walking with a cane, he meets with Teddy
flags.correction: By season's end Franklin has survived the shooting, recovered under Alton's care over several months, and is back in the game walking with a cane.

flags.claim: his knowledge of Teddy's CIA identity [is] still buried
flags.evidence: He reveals he knows Teddy works for the CIA, then agrees to take on more cocaine and reminds him of the promise that they would be partners until the end.
flags.correction: Franklin tells Teddy to his face that he knows he works for the CIA in the season finale, so it is no longer buried between them.

results.cliff: Moloch, Henry and Katrina are all dead — Katrina by Ichabod's own hand in 1781, after she tried to erase him from history. Irving is back and freed of his contract, but Ichabod is a widower and the Headless Horseman still walks free.
Ralphie has the capo seat Tony wanted to keep from him, Meadow is quietly done with what her father does, and an undercover FBI agent has just become Adriana's best friend.

Jax is SAMCRO's new president, tied to the Galindo cartel whose true intentions have just been revealed, with Tara injured and trapped beside him. Clay is stripped of the gavel but still breathing — and Jax knows he killed Piney and ordered Tara's shooting.
Pussy and Richie are gone and Tony's crew is smaller and tighter, but the FBI walked out of the airport with Livia and Melfi still cannot say why she keeps taking Tony's money.
Tony is living alone in his dead mother's house, his marriage in ruins over infidelities Carmela will no longer overlook, and Adriana is trapped between the Bureau and the boy she is about to marry.
Tara is dead on the kitchen floor, killed by Gemma over a betrayal Jax never learned about. Only Gemma and Juice know what happened, and Jax is about to walk in.

The war with New York is won at devastating cost — Bobby dead, Silvio in a coma, capo Carlo flipped to the Feds — and Tony sits with Carmela, Meadow and A.J. in a diner as a stranger walks past to the men's room and the screen cuts to black.
Gi-hun has walked away from his flight to his daughter and picked a fight with the Front Man by phone, with no way in besides the Recruiter and no idea Jun-ho survived.
Tony is home and back with Carmela, but Phil Leotardo has a killed brother to answer for, Adriana is missing without explanation, and the Feds just watched Tony run from a Mafia summit.
Discovery has followed Burnham and the red signals through a wormhole nine centuries into the future to hide the Sphere data from Control. Pike, Spock, and everyone Burnham has known are behind her.

The DMA is gone, Earth has rejoined the Federation, and Species 10-C are learning to atone. Burnham and her crew are stronger than ever; Book, still Kwejian's last survivor, is serving a sentence far from her side.
The war is over and Burnham is a pardoned commander again. Discovery is on its way to Vulcan to pick up a new captain when it receives a distress call from the USS Enterprise.
Gi-hun's uprising has collapsed with his allies dead around him and the Front Man's mask back on. Jun-ho is closer to the island than ever, still unaware his captain works for his brother.

The cause of the Burn is known, Osyraa is dead, the Emerald Chain has collapsed, and Discovery is captained by Michael Burnham. She and Book criss-cross the galaxy delivering dilithium to worlds the Burn cut off from each other.

flags.claim: Discovery is captained by Michael Burnham. She and Book criss-cross the galaxy delivering dilithium to worlds the Burn cut off from each other
flags.evidence: Burnham is promoted to captain... Discovery sets out to bring dilithium from the nebula to planets that have been cut off by the Burn.
flags.correction: Burnham is promoted to captain and Discovery (not Burnham and Book personally) sets out to deliver dilithium; the source does not state Book accompanies her on these deliveries.

results.cliff: Number One is under arrest for being Illyrian, and Pike quietly carries the certainty that his own paralysis is the price of saving Spock and preventing war.
Picard walks out of death in a synthetic body, the synth ban lifted and the Zhat Vash exposed. His crew disperses across the quadrant, each carrying their own unfinished business.
Picard is home with Elnor alive, Laris waiting, and Q apparently dead. Jurati's benevolent Borg join the Federation as provisional members, watching a newly detected trans-warp conduit.

The Progenitors' technology is at the bottom of a black hole. Saru has married and left, Rayner runs the bridge, and years later Admiral Burnham has parked a restored Discovery at unnamed coordinates for a mission Zora will not attempt for a very long time.
The Cayuga is destroyed, Batel is dying with Gorn eggs inside her, and La'An, M'Benga, Ortegas, and Sam Kirk are Gorn captives. Pike has been ordered to retreat but cannot leave them.
Kanan is a prisoner of Grand Moff Tarkin. A call to rebellion has gone out across the sector for the first time, and the Inquisitor is still hunting the crew's remaining Jedi.
Batel has fused herself with the Vezda prison to save Pike and the ship, and the Enterprise heads back into uncharted space with Pike hollowed out by her loss.
The squad is scattered from the only home they ever knew, hunted as fugitives with Omega in tow. Crosshair has chosen the Empire, and Nala Se has vanished into a hidden Imperial research facility.
Hemlock is dead, Tantiss is shut down, and the Bad Batch have retired to Pabu with Omega. Years later, a now-grown Omega leaves the island to join the rebellion against the Empire.

Zach's nuclear detonation freed the Master from the silver sarcophagus and blotted out the sun. Eichhorst has taken Zach, the strigoi can now walk freely in daylight, and Setrakian's survivors are scattered underground amid the fallout.

The crew is racing toward Malachor, an unknown Sith world, on Yoda's cryptic instruction. Vader is personally hunting them, and Ahsoka now knows the man behind the mask is her old master Anakin Skywalker.

Setrakian finally holds the Occido Lumen, the key to killing the Master, but Nora is dead and Zach has been carried off to the Master's side. Palmer has been betrayed by the Master and is dying without another dose of the rejuvenating white.
The Borg and Changeling threats are broken and the Enterprise-D crew are back in their places. But Q — thought dead — has appeared to Ensign Jack Crusher, announcing that his trial has just begun.

Tech is dead, Omega is a prisoner inside Mount Tantiss alongside Crosshair, and the surviving squad is broken and injured on Ord Mantell. The Empire's cloning program finally has the subject it has been chasing since the pilot.

The Master survived sunlight and escaped with his lieutenants intact. Palmer's promised immortality has been reduced to a single dose of health, and the Ancients have just recruited Gus to hunt the Master themselves.
Will is home for Christmas but hiding visions of the Upside Down and a slug he can feel inside him. Eleven is gone after killing the Demogorgon, and no one knows whether she survived it.

The gate is closed and the lab shuttered, but the Mind Flayer is still standing on the other side of the veil, having seen every face in the party. Mike and Eleven, Max and Lucas are couples now; Hopper is legally her father.

The Upside Down is destroyed and Vecna is dead, but Eleven stayed on the other side to collapse it. 18 months later Hopper has proposed to Joyce, the party has graduated, and Mike is still insisting Eleven survived — with no proof either way.

Kendall has been neutralised by Logan's cover-up of a young man's death; the hostile takeover is dead and he is back in the fold on his father's terms. But Greg still has secret copies of the cruises documents, and Stewy and Sandy still own a stake in the company.

Kendall has just declared open war on his father live on television, wielding the documents Greg secretly kept from season one. Logan, watching the broadcast, smiles — nobody yet knows whether he is proud, wounded, or already three moves ahead.
The Master and his lieutenants are dead. Eph, Setrakian, Quinlan and Zach paid the price, and five years on the nuclear winter is receding — the survivors are quietly rebuilding what was lost.
Sugar has stayed behind on Earth as his people depart, hunting Henry — a fellow polyglot who abetted a serial killer for research and who may know what happened to Sugar's missing sister Djen.

The Roy siblings have finally teamed up to stop their father, only to learn Caroline has quietly signed away their veto rights. Logan is free to sell Waystar to Matsson, and Tom has already sold Shiv out for a promotion she does not yet know about.

flags.claim: Tom has already sold Shiv out for a promotion she does not yet know about
flags.evidence: Tom is revealed to have tipped off Logan about the Roy siblings' revolt.
flags.correction: The season ends by revealing Tom's betrayal to the audience; while Shiv herself is not shown learning of it on-screen, the framing 'she does not yet know' overstates what the source establishes about her awareness — the source only shows the reveal, not her ignorance.

results.cliff: Susannah's cancer is finally in the open and she has agreed to treatment. Conrad has just kissed Belly on the beach — but Jeremiah has already told her he loves her.

Waystar has been sold to GoJo; Tom is the new CEO, chosen by Matsson because he will obey. Kendall has lost everything he was raised to inherit, Shiv has voted for the man who beat her out of the chair, and Roman has accepted that none of them were ever going to be Logan.

Vecna's four killings have torn open rifts that let the Upside Down pour into Hawkins itself, and Max is in a coma after briefly dying in Lucas's arms. Hopper is home, Eleven has her powers back, and Will can feel that Vecna is still alive.
The wedding fell apart on the day. Belly and Conrad chose each other in Paris; Jeremiah, cut off by Adam, is starting again in a kitchen, and Steven and Taylor are heading to San Francisco.
Susannah is gone, but the beach house is saved. Belly is with Jeremiah; Conrad has retreated to Cousins alone after burying his feelings for her a second time.
Fu's Prison Planet is destroyed and Goku is stranded on top of it. Fusion Zamasu, supposedly gone, has just arrived with four unknown allies and made off with Cumber.
Hearts is dead and his gang is scattered, but the true architect of everything since the Prison Planet, Fu, watches from a hidden lab and declares that his next experiment is about to begin.

Hopper is presumed dead after Joyce closed the Russian gate on top of him, and the Byers family and a powerless Eleven have left Hawkins for California. In Kamchatka, Russian guards are keeping a captive Demogorgon fed with prisoners, and warned to spare one specifically called 'the American'.

Lex Luthor is out of prison and vowing revenge on the family who put him there; on the moon, Superman and a Doomsday built from Bizarro's corpse are hurtling at each other in a fight nobody has won yet.
Ally is caged and the worlds separated, but a visitor has just told John Henry Irons that this Earth's version of him was murdered by a Metropolis crime boss named Bruno Mannheim.
Gus and the other hybrids are caged inside Abbot's Preserve while Singh is forced to hunt a cure. Jepperd and Aimee are coming for them, and Birdie has finally surfaced from the Arctic.
Tal-Rho is caged and the Subjekts reversed, but a Kryptonian death-arsenal now exists in DOD hands and Irons's daughter Natalie has just stepped out of an escape pod into a family she has never met.
With the Sick cured and the tree destroyed, Gus's friends build a hybrid sanctuary at Yellowstone. Years later, an elderly Gus finishes his story to the children gathered around him.

The war with Luthor is over. Doomsday died sacrificing himself, Lex is buried in Stryker's for life, and Superman has told the world his name — then the show flashes across decades until Lois dies of returning cancer and, years later, Clark dies reunited with her.
Gus and his rescued friends are racing north to find Birdie in Alaska, chased by Zhang's forces and shadowed by Singh, who is still convinced Gus holds the cure.

Newly promoted Richmond will re-enter the Premier League against Rupert's newly acquired West Ham United, whose head coach is Nate — the man Ted mentored, who just leaked Ted's panic attack to the press and defected. Rebecca has ended her secret affair with Sam, and Keeley is starting her own PR firm.

Ted has returned to Kansas to coach his son's soccer team, leaving Richmond in the hands of new head coach Roy Kent. Nate is back at the club, Rebecca has sold 49 percent of it to the fans, and has just recognised the Dutch pilot who once rescued her from a canal as the father of a child at the airport.

The Bear has opened, but its first service has broken Carmy's relationship with Claire and detonated his relationship with Richie. Marcus's mother's caretaker is calling and he isn't answering, and Cicero's 18-month loan clock is ticking.

The Tribune review sits unread on Carmy's phone alongside frantic messages from Cicero. Sydney is holding Adam Shapiro's offer without ever signing Carmy's contract, and The Bear's future is one notification away from being decided for them.
The Beef is closing but The Bear doesn't yet exist. Michael's hidden money buys Carmy a chance he isn't remotely prepared to take; Sydney has just come back, and Richie is facing a felony.

The Bear has two Michelin stars but is only barely staying open. Carmy is interviewing at an architecture firm, Sydney runs the kitchen, Richie has boarded a plane to Japan with Jess, and Ebra is building a franchise around the sandwich window that started it all.

President Rayburn is dead of shock on a call with Hal, and Grace Penn — the person Kate has just learned engineered the attack on the British carrier — is being sworn in as President of the United States.
Nick is dead, the friend group has agreed to keep travelling in his honour, and Ginny — the young girlfriend he left Anne for — is pregnant with his child.

Kate has just realised that her plan to entomb the Russian submarine was cover for a covert US operation to steal the Poseidon warhead — an operation Hal and President Penn ran without her, and one the Russians may soon blame the British for.
