A car bomb has just torn through Hal, Hayford and Ronnie at a meeting Kate had forbidden. She is convinced the British prime minister ordered both the attack on his own ship and the bomb outside her embassy.
Bertha has forced society to bow at the Russells' ball just as Marian is publicly jilted, and Peggy has left New York to find the son she was told had died at birth.
Danny and Claude are giving up Italy to move in with Danny's mother in Philadelphia; Anne is house-sitting alone in their Italian home when a neighbour comes to the door.
Bertha has won the Opera War by secretly bartering Gladys to a duke, Ada's surprise inheritance has upended who runs the van Rhijn house, and Larry and Marian have just kissed on the front step.

AFC Richmond have been relegated to the Championship despite Ted's culture change; Ted and Rebecca have committed to earning promotion next season and eventually winning the Premier League. Roy has just injured his knee in the final match and kissed Keeley for the first time.

George survives a shooting only to tell Bertha they will now live apart, blaming her ambition for what happened to their children. Gladys returns pregnant from England, Peggy is engaged to Dr. Kirkland, and Oscar has just proposed a marriage of convenience to the newly widowed Mrs. Winterton.
Mapleton has burned the Guilty Remnant to the ground. Kevin, Jill and Nora stand on the porch with an abandoned baby in Nora's arms, while Laurie, having finally spoken, is nowhere in the picture.

Cicero's countdown clock has reached zero. Carmy has quit not just The Bear but cooking entirely, quietly handing the restaurant to Sydney, Natalie and Cicero — with Sydney made lead partner after turning down Adam Shapiro's offer to stay.
Stacy has walked out on her New York life for good and returned alone to the ranch beside Preston's grave, with her daughters and their families still back east and Cade the only person beside her.
In a small Australian cottage decades on, elderly Nora has told elderly Kevin the whole story of the machine and the world of the missing 98%, and he says he believes her.
Charlie is dead, ACN belongs to Lucas Pruit, and Mac is now running the network with Jim in her old EP chair. Will is out of jail, married to Mac, and expecting a baby; Maggie is heading to DC.
Miracle has been overrun by the Guilty Remnant and Evie has revealed she is with them. Kevin has died and come back a second time, and finds his entire scattered family sitting in his living room.

Robby is off the roof but hollow. The shift ended with Langdon sent home for theft, McKay arrested, Dana ready to quit, and the ER staggering out of a mass shooting that killed Jake's girlfriend Leah.
News Night has survived Leona's attempt to end it, but the threat was only defused when it emerged that TMI got its dirt by hacking Mac's voicemail — and Will and Mac are still not reconciled.
Jesse has fled to Haiti to win back Gideon after Amber threw him out, and the three siblings have been fired from the ministry with everything to prove to their father.
ACN has retracted Genoa, kept its senior staff, and paired off Will–Mac and Don–Sloan, but the retraction has gutted the network's credibility and Jerry Dantana is suing.
The family survives one more attack together: Kelvin and Keefe are married, and Eli sails off with Lori, leaving the church fully in his children's hands.

flags.claim: leaving the church fully in his children's hands
flags.evidence: Later, Eli officiates Kelvin's and Keefe's wedding, and then returns to his yacht in Florida, where Lori appears, offering to be his first mate.
flags.correction: The source does not state that Eli hands the church over to his children; it only shows him returning to his yacht in Florida after officiating the wedding.

results.cliff: The William secret has just cracked open and reset the Pearsons: Randall has walked away from his career, Kevin is heading off to meet Ron Howard, Kate is chasing music with Toby, and no one has yet said how Jack died.

The siblings have finally agreed to run the ministry as equals, Kelvin has kissed Keefe in front of everyone, and Eli has stepped aside for good — leaving three untested leaders in charge of a huge church.
With the Lissons dead and Zion's Landing seized, the Gemstones look victorious, but Eli has been quietly stepping back and the question of who actually runs the church is still open.

The Pearsons are scattered—Randall and Beth reinventing themselves in Philadelphia, Kate and Toby fighting for a fragile newborn, Kevin single after losing Zoe, Nicky freshly back in the family. A future flash promises an aged Rebecca is in trouble.

Kevin and Madison have called off the wedding on the day; Kevin is charged with building the house Jack always promised Rebecca. Kate and Toby are quietly drifting apart, and flash-forwards promise Kate will remarry Phillip and Kevin will end up with someone still unseen.

The show has ended. Rebecca and Miguel are gone, Kate is married to Phillip, Kevin is back with Sophie, Randall is a senator eyeing higher office, and Deja will name her son William. The Big Three have promised each other they will not drift.

flags.claim: Kate is married to Phillip
flags.evidence: Years later, with Toby's tacit acceptance and her children's enthusiastic support, Kate marries Philip
flags.correction: The husband's name is spelled Philip, not Phillip

results.cliff: Three girls stand united inside Aunt Lydia's school and Daisy has sent June word that she will finish what her mother started. Lydia sits on a dossier that could burn down the regime, MacKenzie's Japan arms deal is still hidden, and a humiliated Weston is now an enemy.

Robby is finally leaving, but on a safer trip after Abbot pulled him back from the edge. Santos is hiding scalpel kits, Dana may lose her license, Langdon is only halfway rehabilitated, and Al-Hashimi has been forced off shift by returning seizures.

Rachel is under Trigon's control after Dick's dark vision broke her heart, and Dick himself has been enslaved by the demon. Only Gar, revived by Trigon, still stands with them inside a house sealed off from the rest of the team.
Dick has taken up Nightwing and formed a new team, but Rachel is on Themyscira trying to raise Donna, Jason has gone off alone, and Blackfire has just seized a human host on Earth.

Gotham is saved and the Titans are heading back to San Francisco whole again, with Tim Drake as the new Robin. But Kory carries a new blue-light power she cannot fully control, and Rachel has just used the Lazarus Pit's darkness as a weapon.

Rebecca has agreed to the clinical trial, Kevin and Randall have said things they cannot unsay, Madison is carrying Kevin's twins, and Kate and Toby are ready to adopt. A future glimpse hints at a daughter named Hailey.

Reyes is toppled, Bonalde is Venezuela's new president, and Jack, Greer and Mike fly out cleanly. Greer's heart condition is still hanging over him and the team has been forged into a unit that operates well past the letter of its orders.

The Sokol coup is broken, war is averted, and Jack and Greer receive the Intelligence Star from Wright. Luka Goncharov, the Russian who made it all possible, is taken away and, it is implied, quietly killed for his part.

The fangbanger killer is dead and Sookie and Bill are together, but a fresh corpse has just turned up in Andy Bellefleur's car outside Merlotte's — and Lafayette has been jumped and dragged off by someone unseen.

The Suleiman network is dismantled and Samir is returned to Hanin. Greer is promoted to deputy station chief in Moscow, Jack replaces him running T-FAD, and Cathy is left knowing Jack has lied to her about who he is.
Sookie has just decided to marry Bill, and now Bill has been snatched out of a French restaurant. Sookie has no idea by whom, or why.
Russell is buried alive in concrete, Bill has invited Queen Sophie-Anne over for a duel to the death, and Sookie has just walked into the faerie world with Claudine.
Bill has drunk Lilith's blood, exploded in a pool of gore, and re-formed as something monstrous. Eric is screaming at Sookie to run.

Sanger is dead and the Titans have chosen to go their separate ways: Gar back to the Red, Rachel to community college in Blüdhaven, Tim to guard both Metropolis and Gotham, and Conner to spend time with Superman — while Dick and Kory finally commit to being together.
Tara is bleeding out on Sookie's kitchen floor from a shotgun blast meant for Sookie. Bill has just killed the AVL's spokeswoman, and somewhere out there Russell Edgington is loose again.

The Pearsons finally know how Jack died, but they've just learned he had a brother nobody knew about. Kate is newly married, Kevin is sober and pointed at Vietnam with Zoe, and a future glimpse warns Toby is about to fall apart.

Hepatitis V has spread nationwide and turned infected vampires into feral killers. As Bon Temps hosts its first vampire-pairing meeting at Bellefleur's, a horde of infected vampires descends on the party.

There is no cliffhanger — this is the series finale. Bill is dead in his Civil War grave; Sookie has a husband and a child on the way; Eric and Pam are billionaires; Sarah Newlin sits chained in the Fangtasia basement, milked forever.
The Zeyara–triad–cartel network is broken, the bombs are stopped at the border, and Miller's Pluto program is publicly tied to a sitting US senator. Wright is confirmed CIA Director.

Dwight has crushed Ming, cleared Chickie out of New York with Bevilaqua's help, and been handed peace on his own terms — only to be seized at gunpoint by unknown masked men at Margaret's ranch. The FBI has just opened a file on him.

Dwight has killed Dunmire, freed Joanne, and walked away with a federal liquor licence and the intel Musso wanted. But Ray Renzetti in New York now knows the hitman he sent has switched sides, and Bevilaqua is still in a cell over Dwight's FBI arrangement.
Cooper stands in the street outside a Palmer house that isn't the Palmer house, holding a screaming woman who may or may not be Laura. He asks, 'What year is this?'
Cooper lies bleeding on his hotel floor while the mill burns down around Catherine and Shelly. Laura's real killer is still at large, and Audrey has been trafficked to her own father.

The moon has been shattered by Vanya's power and the world has ended. Five has yanked the siblings into the past mid-apocalypse to try again — but nobody knows where or when they landed, or whether they can control Vanya before she does it a second time.

Dwight is in handcuffs outside his own casino, betrayed by the ATF agent he slept with, using the flash drive he gave her as evidence. Back in New York, Chickie now runs the Invernizzi family and wants him dead.

Allison's secret deal with Reginald has rebooted the universe. The siblings are alive and scattered but stripped of their powers, Luther's body is human again, Sloane is missing, and a new Reginald is running the city with a resurrected wife nobody has met before. In a mid-credits shot, Ben rides a Seoul subway to a destination he hasn't explained.

The siblings have stepped into the Cleanse and let it consume them and Ben, collapsing every timeline into one. A cluster of real marigold flowers has blossomed beneath a giant sycamore in the surviving world, generating pollen that looks a lot like the elixir that started everything.

The dome's black curtain has been replaced by blinding white light after Julia hid the egg in the lake, but Barbie still stands at the gallows with Big Jim's frame job intact and the noose around his neck.

The siblings finally make it back to 2019 — except it isn't theirs. Reginald raised a completely different team called the Sparrow Academy, Ben is alive and hostile, and the family they knew here has been erased.

flags.claim: Ben is alive and hostile
flags.evidence: She hugs him as his ghostly form departs for the afterlife.
flags.correction: The Ben the siblings knew departed for the afterlife earlier in the finale. The 'still-alive Ben' in the altered 2019 is a different version in the Sparrow Academy; the source does not describe him as hostile.

results.cliff: Barbie and the townspeople have reached a wall inside the crater tunnel that crumbled to reveal Melanie alive; Julia is stranded on the far side of a widening chasm, and a wounded, murderous Big Jim has been left behind in Chester's Mill.

Turner has solved Lucy's death and learned his ex-wife had their son's killer murdered, and he walks away from Yosemite leaving Vasquez his horse. Whether he can live with any of it, and whether Vasquez can hold the park alone, is left hanging.

One year after the dome fell, Big Jim is a sitting Congressman selling the sanitised version of events; Hunter, now with the NSA, has finally traced Barbie's daughter Dawn to Omaha, where she is standing over three children about to touch a different egg.

Nathan finally knows he was murdered and that he betrayed Jamie by selling Beyond to Ingrid's father, but he is trapped in Lakeview with Ingrid — who has just announced she has uploaded herself to be with him forever — while his data runs out and Nora vanishes off the grid to save her own life.
Vanessa has wounded Dmitri and just laid eyes on her turned daughter Dylan for the first time. Axel has walked out of the sealed Farm as a vampire himself.
The Elder has bitten Vanessa and her eyes have turned red. Dmitri is dead, but the Sisterhood under Scab is intact and Sam now has Mohamad as a vampire disciple.
Sam is now a horned Fourth Elder under the Oracle's command. Scarlett is dead, Axel has walked away vowing hatred, and Vanessa stands over her ancestor Lily Van Helsing, newly revived by her blood.

Dracula walks the earth wearing both the President's face and Jack's. Violet and Ivory have been gunned down trying to stop her, Axel and Julius lie wounded at the Sunshine Unit, and the real Jack is sealed inside a coffin in the Dark Realm.

Vanessa lies in a death-like coma with the Dark One sealed inside her; Axel keeps watch over her body. Daylight has returned, vampires are human again, and Olivia adjusts to a world five centuries removed from her own.
Cooper has walked out of the Black Lodge with BOB inside him. Audrey lies in the smoke of the bank bombing, Annie is left wounded, and the real Cooper's whereabouts are unknown.
Ragnar is now king of Kattegat with two wives' worth of sons, including Ivar, kept alive against Norse custom. Athelstan is back at his side but praying to both Christ and Odin.

Ragnar sails home from a failed embassy carrying two secrets: Rollo has promised his sword to Jarl Borg, and Princess Aslaug is on her way to Kattegat pregnant with his child. Lagertha still does not know Aslaug exists.

Ragnar sails home broken, knowing Floki murdered Athelstan and saying nothing about it. His brother Rollo has taken Frankish titles and Princess Gisla in exchange for keeping the Northmen out of Paris.

Ragnar is dead in a snake pit and his sons have crossed the sea with the great heathen army to punish everyone who wronged him. Ivar has just killed his brother Sigurd in front of the whole camp; Lagertha rules Kattegat over Aslaug's grave.
Ivar has been driven out of Kattegat and fled east with a handful of loyalists; Bjorn is king. In a vision, the Seer warns him that the war is not over.

Ragnar's line is spent: Bjorn buried in Kattegat, Ivar dying willingly on a Wessex field, Hvitserk baptised as Alfred's godson under the name Athelstan, and only Ubbe still building anything, in a new land across the ocean where he has found Floki alive.

Nathan is on the run in the real world with Nora in a fragile clone body whose nose has started to bleed — the download-failure sign that killed Rupert Tilford live on TV. Back in Lakeview a backup Nathan wakes with no memory of anything since his upload, while Ingrid holds a hair from his brush and quietly plans to carry his child.

flags.claim: the download-failure sign that killed Rupert Tilford live on TV
flags.evidence: The season 2 source never mentions Rupert Tilford.
flags.correction: Rupert Tilford is not referenced anywhere in the season 2 plot summaries; only Nathan's own nosebleed as a download-failure sign is stated.

results.cliff: Freydís and Leif sail into the western unknown for a land she has only seen in visions; Harald sits alone on Norway's throne longing for the son he has never met; in London, Emma quietly steers a boy king while Godwin nurses his losses.
The group is homeless again, driving east with no plan while Shane and Rick circle each other over Lori. Rick alone knows Jenner's secret, and hasn't told anyone.
Kattegat stands, but only barely. Olaf's coup collapsed when Forkbeard's fleet arrived; Harald and Freydís are wounded fugitives, and Leif is unrecognisable in his grief for Liv.
The group is homeless again with a fractured leader, a pregnant Lori, and a prison on the horizon they might have to fight for. Andrea is missing and in a stranger's hands.
The prison is safer than ever with Woodbury's citizens absorbed, but the Governor is loose with a small crew, humiliated and vengeful. Rick has stepped back from sole command.
Rick's group is locked inside a Terminus boxcar. Carol, Tyreese and Judith are still on the road. Beth was kidnapped by a car with a white cross on its window.
Rick's group kneels in a clearing; Negan has just bludgeoned one of them to death, but the audience does not know who. Everyone Rick loves is watching.
The war is over and Rick has kept Negan alive in a cell. Maggie vows to move against Rick in the future, and the communities have to rebuild from scratch.
Rick has publicly killed a townsman with Alexandria watching, and Deanna has sanctioned it. A pack called the Wolves has already been marking houses beyond the walls.
Rick's coalition — Alexandria, Hilltop, Kingdom — is now openly at war with Negan. Eugene is inside the Sanctuary as a defector, and Sasha has just died as a decoy.
A whole line of Rick's people are on pikes, the Kingdom is abandoned to a blizzard, and someone unknown is transmitting on the radio for anyone still alive to answer.
Michonne is gone chasing evidence that Rick lives. Eugene's group is a hostage of a rich, uniformed society. Maggie has returned with a new group being hunted by an unknown enemy called the Reapers.
Nevermore is closed for the semester. Tyler sits in custody as the Hyde, Weems is dead by Laurel Gates's hand, and Enid has finally triggered her werewolf transformation.
Nancy has just discovered her new boyfriend Peter is a DEA agent, at the exact moment she's committed to grow her own crop with Conrad.

Nevermore has closed again. Enid has run north as an alpha werewolf, Tyler has been taken in by Isadora Capri's secret pack of Hydes, and Grandmama Frump's captive daughter Ophelia is writing 'Wednesday Must Die' in blood on her cell wall.
The Commonwealth is under new leadership, but the story's oldest thread — Rick's fate — is open again. Rick is a captive of the CRM, and Daryl and Michonne are separately hunting for him.

Nancy stands surrounded by five drawn guns — U-Turn wants his cut, Kashishian's men want their fee for Peter, the MILF is missing, and Celia is confronting Silas in her driveway with the entire stolen stash.

flags.claim: Celia is confronting Silas in her driveway with the entire stolen stash
flags.evidence: Seconds later, Celia and a police officer approach Silas and his car in which the pot is hidden.
flags.correction: Celia approaches Silas with a police officer at his car; the source does not specify her driveway.

results.cliff: Agrestic and Majestic are burning. Nancy has torched her own house, agreed to smuggle for Guillermo, and taken the family somewhere new.
Shane has murdered a powerful cartel-tied political fixer poolside at his stepfather's fundraiser. The family is deep in the Reyes compound with her body.
Esteban knows Nancy betrayed him and was going to have her killed — but she is carrying his child. Her survival is now contingent on delivering him a son.

Freydís rules Jomsborg alone with a newborn and a fragile peace with Ælfgifu; Harald and Leif have arrived in a foreign capital where the woman Harald loves belongs to the Emperor; Emma has quietly warned Godwin she knows what he is.
Nancy has just been shot in the head by an unseen sniper at a Connecticut family dinner. The shooter's identity is unknown.
The series leaves Nancy alone at the spot Judah died, Andy gone for good despite her tearful pleas.

Dolores has crossed into the real world wearing Charlotte Hale's face, carrying five host minds and a rebuilt Bernard she expects to fight her. William is left alone in the abandoned Forge, greeted by a host copy of the daughter he killed.
Ford is dead, killed by an awakened Dolores in front of Delos's leadership as freed hosts turn their guns on the guests. Westworld is no longer a park.

flags.claim: in front of Delos's leadership
flags.evidence: He then gives a speech in front of Charlotte, William, and other guests, criticizing their handling of the park.
flags.correction: The source for this season names the board/company representatives (Charlotte Hale, the Man in Black/William) but never uses the name 'Delos'.

results.cliff: Guillermo has just discovered he descends from the vampire hunter Van Helsing — the exact lineage bred to kill the four creatures he has loyally served for ten years. He tells no one.

The world outside is dying, humans and hosts destroying each other in the streets. Dolores, alone in the Sublime, has begun recreating the original Westworld inside it as one last test for sentient life.

The household has fractured. Nandor waits alone at a train station believing Guillermo stood him up, Guillermo is trapped in Laszlo's coffin bound for London, and Laszlo is hiding on Staten Island with a baby that just burst from Colin Robinson's corpse.

Guillermo has finally given up on Nandor. He has walked out of the household with a suitcase of embezzled club money and asked a low-level vampire he barely knows to give him what his master never would.

Rehoboam is destroyed and humanity is free of its predicted futures. Dolores is dead, but Charlotte survives in secret with a host copy of William, and Bernard has entered the Sublime searching for the one path where the world doesn't end.

Rand is the Dragon Reborn, gone into hiding and terrified of the madness in the male One Power. The Horn of Valere is in Darkfriend hands, and huge foreign ships bearing channelers have just landed on the western shore.

Nancy is being arrested by the FBI outside the airport, confessing to Pilar's murder to save her family. Andy, Silas, Shane and Stevie are on a plane to Copenhagen; Esteban and Guillermo have just been caught.

flags.claim: Andy, Silas, Shane and Stevie are on a plane to Copenhagen
flags.evidence: Andy, Silas, Shane and Mr. Schiff board the plane to Copenhagen (via Paris) ... After Esteban threatens Silas and takes Stevie, Nancy agrees to leave the airport with them
flags.correction: Stevie is not on the plane; Esteban took him, so Stevie is with Nancy/Esteban/Guillermo as the FBI closes in outside the airport.

results.cliff: Rand has been proclaimed the Dragon Reborn before an entire city, still bleeding from Mat's spear. Ishamael is dead — but Moghedien has just told Lanfear that every one of the ancient Forsaken now walks free.
Armond is in the cargo hold and Shane doesn't yet know he killed him. Rachel has chosen the marriage. Tanya has abandoned Belinda and boarded a new life with Greg.

flags.claim: Shane doesn't yet know he killed him
flags.evidence: Shane returns before Armond leaves, and, sensing an intruder, arms himself with a pineapple knife and inadvertently stabs Armond, killing him.
flags.correction: Shane is the one who killed Armond and was present when it happened, so he knows.

results.cliff: Guillermo has just butchered a theatre full of vampires — including most of the East Coast Council — to save his masters. He stands over the bodies as the four finally realise what he actually is.

Rand has been named Car'a'carn of the Aiel — but Couladin rides against him as a fake Car'a'carn, backed by Lanfear and the Forsaken Rahvin. Elaida rules a White Tower openly hostile to him, and Liandrin holds an artifact that can leash him at Moghedien's word.
Kenny's accidental sacrifice ended the storm but not the covenant — the bell has tolled eight more times, and the town's own descendant of Richard Warren is Tom's teenage son.
Tanya is dead in the Ionian Sea, Greg has quietly inherited her fortune, and no one on the outside knows he arranged the hit.

The Barksdales took a plea and the detail is dissolved. Avon and D'Angelo are in prison, Stringer is running the business from a funeral home, and McNulty has been buried on a police boat for embarrassing the brass.
Geralt has Ciri at last, but Yennefer has vanished after burning Nilfgaard's army at Sodden and the North has only just held. Nilfgaard's hunt for Ciri has barely begun.
Wynonna has killed Bobo but lost Dolls to a Black Badge black site. Her sister Waverly, contaminated by residue from the barrier creature, has just raised a gun at her.

Ciri is Bonhart's captive with the Rats slaughtered around her; Geralt's fellowship is closing on Nilfgaard while a monster of Emhyr's making hunts him. Vilgefortz has lost his army but not his obsession, and no one has reached Ciri yet.

Ciri, Geralt and Yennefer are together on the road with a bounty on Ciri's head from the North, Nilfgaard, the elves, Rience's master and the Wild Hunt. Emhyr wants his daughter back and Vilgefortz now knows exactly what she is.

The Brotherhood is destroyed, Vilgefortz has escaped, and Ciri is riding with the Rats under a stolen name while Geralt recovers alone in Brokilon. Emhyr is holding a fake daughter and does not yet know it.

flags.claim: Geralt recovers alone in Brokilon
flags.evidence: As he finds a recovering Geralt, he informs him of rumors about Ciri being on her way to Nilfgaard.
flags.correction: Geralt is not alone in Brokilon — Jaskier visits him there, and by the end of the season Geralt has been healed by Yennefer and sets out with Jaskier and Milva to save Ciri.

results.cliff: Wynonna has broken the Earp curse and every Revenant with it, but Waverly is trapped in the Garden of Eden and Doc has followed her in. The word VALDEZ is carved inside the homestead — a message from somebody who knows what comes next.
Jackie's corpse sits frozen at the cabin door as winter closes in. In 2021, Adam's body has been dumped, but a masked group has just kidnapped Natalie.

A man's voice answers Natalie's satellite call as Mari's body is butchered. In the present, Van is dead, Callie has confessed to killing Lottie and fled with Jeff, and Shauna sits alone in her empty house resolving to reclaim her power.

The cabin is a smoking ruin as spring nears, leaving the team without shelter under Natalie's uneasy leadership. In the present, Natalie is dead, Lottie has been committed, and the Adam investigation has been buried by framing Kevyn.
With the Clantons defeated and Waverly and Nicole married, Wynonna and Doc drive out of Purgatory together. The Earp curse is history and, for the first time, so is the family duty.

flags.claim: With the Clantons defeated
flags.evidence: Rachel releases Billy, who reunites with Cleo. ... Cleo makes Rachel perform a ritual to turn Billy human and the ritual works. ... Cleo kidnaps Rachel but Wynonna saves her. Cleo performs a ritual such that Doc becomes the Clanton heir
flags.correction: Margo and Holt Clanton are dead and the Clanton reapers are turned into birds, but Cleo Clanton is still alive at season's end.

flags.claim: The Earp curse is history and, for the first time, so is the family duty.
flags.evidence: The source for season 4 never mentions the Earp curse being broken or ended; it describes Wynonna recovering Peacemaker, fighting demons throughout, and ends with 'Wynonna and Doc leave Purgatory together' with no statement about the curse ending.
flags.correction: The source does not state the Earp curse is ended at the close of season 4.

results.cliff: Joe is with a woman as dangerous as he is, expecting a child, and locked into suburban domesticity in a new house. He is already stalking the woman next door.
Belinda leaves Thailand rich on Greg's terms. Timothy has finally told his family the truth. Rick, Chelsea and Jim are dead in the villa that started it all.

Jenkins has been strung up until he coughed the names of every player moving against the Yellowstone, and Jamie has just handed a reporter the story of his own father without anyone in the family knowing yet. John has Kayce and Rip back inside the fence, but he is dying, and the men trying to take the ranch now know who each other are.

Joe has literally gotten away with everything: Beck is dead, Dr. Nicky is imprisoned for his crimes, and the bookstore is his again. Then Candace — the ex no one had heard from since — appears with a promise of unfinished business.
Bulshar Clootie is loose and his ring sits on Nicole's finger. Baby Alice is being raised outside the Triangle by Perry, and Wynonna is on the road to a mother she barely knows.
The show is over. Joe is imprisoned for life, his victims have rebuilt their lives without him, and he sits in his cell reading fan mail from strangers who think society is the real problem.

Ashe is at the bottom of a lake but his car has just surfaced, and Mel has seen DeMille handing Coop something. Nick has fired Barney and blown up his marriage; Elena has cleared her debts by letting a drug dealer rob Nick's mansion; Coop's inner circle is fracturing on every side.

Joe has burned his life in Madre Linda to the ground and cast Love as the sole villain of it. He has abandoned his infant son and gone to Paris chasing Marienne, who fled him in fear the moment she learned who he really was.
Joe has stopped fighting his nature. He is back in New York with Kate — now one of the most powerful women in the country — and a rebuilt public image as the man Love Quinn tortured.

flags.claim: now one of the most powerful women in the country
flags.evidence: he awakens in the hospital to find Kate, who tells him she has inherited all her father's assets... Joe moves back to New York City with Kate, who runs her father's business after his death
flags.correction: Kate inherits her father's assets and runs his business, but the source does not describe her as one of the most powerful women in the country — and the setting is New York, not necessarily 'the country' as a scope the source addresses

results.cliff: Murphy is being ferried by Dr. Merch and a submarine crew to a zombie-free island called Zona. 10K, taken from the house alongside Murphy, has vanished by the time the team reaches the beach, and the rest of the team has been captured by unidentified foreign guards. In the final image, Murphy's abandoned daughter hosts a tea party with docile zombies.

Murphy's exit from the CDC lab without decontamination has triggered a worldwide nuclear launch. He is leaving with a stranger who claims to be taking him the rest of the way to California, while warheads close in on Citizen Z's Arctic outpost.

Coop has beaten a murder charge and been welcomed back into Westmont — but instead of returning to Jack's firm he's stolen from him and doubled down on the burglaries. Everyone he loves believes he is innocent of everything.
